jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Software ontwikkelen waar de hele samenleving mee in aanraking komt. Samen met je DevOps-team. Software voor geboorteregistratie tot pensioenuitkering, van planningssystemen in het OV tot de software voor de robotisering van distributiecentra. Veilig, betrouwbaar, 100% vakmanschap. Met jouw drive om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen in jouw vakgebied wil je uitgroeien tot de top van de IT.

Om je goed voor te bereiden op het werk binnen onze projecten, start je met verschillende vakinhoudelijke trainingen. Daarna word je onderdeel van een van onze DevOps-teams en ga je aan de slag voor een klant. Samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en opleveren van een functionaliteit of voor de gehele applicatie. Je werkt vanuit verschillende disciplines nauw samen en zet het technisch ontwerp op. Daarvan bouw jij een deel, of het geheel van de programmatuur. Samen met de Requirements Engineer schrijf je de technische programmaspecificaties. Tijdens het project controleer, test en onderhoud je de software. Je vindt constant manieren om de applicatie te verbeteren.

Wat bied jij Info Support?

Je bent een ambitieuze developer die kwaliteit levert. Je leert snel vanwege je diepgaande interesse in IT, staat met beide benen op de grond en kunt goed samenwerken. Je bijt je graag vast in complexe vraagstukken, zodat jij de beste oplossing kan bieden aan de klant.

Verder heb jij:

Een afgeronde bachelor/master ICT of gelijkwaardig;
Een passie voor softwareontwikkeling;
Ambitie om je te ontwikkelen tot een ware vakprofessional;
Een brede interesse in het Java of .NET-platform;
Maximaal 3 jaar werkervaring als softwareontwikkelaar.

Wat biedt Info Support jou?

Uiteraard bieden we je een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden met verschillende keuzemogelijkheden. Denk hierbij aan:

Vakantiegeld, winstuitkering, onkostenvergoeding, bijdrage pensioen
Leasebudget met tankpas (ook voor het buitenland)
Laptop en smartphone (of BYOD), facilitering thuiswerkplek
Een startsalaris vanaf €3.400 bruto, op basis van 40 uur

Gedurende de eerste twee jaar van je dienstverband volg je onder werktijd naast vakinhoudelijke cursussen en opleidingen regelmatig sociale, bedrijfskundige en commerciële trainingen. Na die twee jaar kan je daardoor eventueel al doorgroeien naar andere rollen.

Ook na de eerste twee jaar krijgt je alle ruimte om je nog verder te ontwikkelen en je doelen en ambities waar te maken. Daar helpen we je bij door samen met jou een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan op te stellen waarin jij op inhoudelijk én persoonlijk vlak nog verder kunt groeien.

Daarnaast biedt Info Support jou:

Collegiale en gepassioneerde IT-collega’s die je continu uitdagen en verder brengen
Veel vrijheid in hoe je je werk indeelt en uitvoert
Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende bedrijven die ervoor kiezen hun complexe vraagstukken bij Info Support neer te leggen
Een gegarandeerde plek in een van onze communities waar je op de hoogte blijft van de allerlaatste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied
Veel ruimte voor vakinhoudelijke en persoonlijke ontwikkeling door opleiding, training, coaching en conferenties
Leuke team-, unit- en bedrijfsuitjes en de mogelijkheid om je aan te sluiten bij de kook-, boeken-, gaming-, cycle-, muziek- of (mud)runclub of een nieuwe club te starten
Werken bij een solide groeiende en financieel gezonde werkgever!

Over Info Support

Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst.

De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan.

Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een Inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
An Amazing Career Opportunity for a Principal Software Engineer

Location:
Veldhoven, Netherlands

Job ID:
47231

IAI industrial systems has been a supplier to the security printing market since 1995. Some of the largest countries in the world have chosen IAI as their preferred partner to help them create passports, identity cards and banknotes with the most advanced security features. Many leading governments, technology partners and enterprises around the world entrust their challenging projects with us, as they value the reliability, accountability and responsibility we deliver. From new levels of protection and productivity for passports and identity cards to novel manufacturing processes and technologies that pave the way to new breakthroughs. We have built our reputation on developing and manufacturing unique systems, which include laser applications, inkjet printing and product handling. Characteristics of our markets are international, business-to-business, investment goods and long-term relations. IAI industrial systems is part of HID Global, a subsidiary of ASSA ABLOY.

Who are we?

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.

We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo

Summary

The Principal Software Engineer is a hands‑on software developer with extended responsibility for the technical design, quality, and long‑term maintainability of key software components and subsystems within IAI’s machines and software platforms. In this role, the Principal Software Engineer acts as a technical owner at component and subsystem level, contributing actively to system and platform architecture decisions while remaining deeply involved in implementation, testing, and validation on machines. The role combines strong execution capability with architectural awareness, technical mentoring, and a clear ownership mindset. The Principal Software Engineer works in multidisciplinary project teams and collaborates closely with software, mechanical, electrical, A&T, service, and project colleagues to deliver robust, high‑quality software that meets current and future product requirements.

Essential Duties

Software Development & Implementation

Develop software from specification through design, implementation, testing, integration, and documentation
Remain actively hands‑on in coding, debugging, integration, and validation of software on machines
Analyze customer and system requirements and translate them into high‑quality software solutions

Technical Ownership & Architecture

Act as technical owner for assigned software components and subsystems, taking responsibility for design choices, code quality, maintainability, and long‑term evolution
Contribute to system and platform architecture decisions and ensure alignment with agreed architectural principles and standards
Ensure that software designs are robust, scalable, and suitable for reuse across products where applicable

Quality, Standards & Security

Ensure software is developed according to agreed coding standards, architectural guidelines, and best practices
Apply secure and robust software development practices appropriate for industrial systems and customer environments

Testing, Validation & Maintenance

Test and validate software functionality against specifications
Analyze and resolve software‑related issues in delivered machines and installations

Primary Duties

Software Development & Integration

Integrate third party software components where required

Quality & Continuous Improvement

Perform and contribute to code reviews, actively managing technical debt and improving overall software quality
Ensure proper documentation of changes and maintain up to date software documentation and manuals

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

Work closely with multidisciplinary teams to translate user requirements into functional software solutions
Act as a technical mentor for software engineers, supporting their development through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing
Support Assembly & Test and Service Engineers by providing technical expertise, training, and knowledge transfer

Platform Awareness & Engineering Improvement

Develop software with awareness of platform level impact, long term maintainability, and consistency across products
Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of software architectures, tools, and development practices within Engineering

Qualifications

Proven experience in software development for industrial or hardware‑related applications
Strong experience in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining complex software systems
Experience working in multidisciplinary project environments
Strong proficiency in software development (e.g. C#, C/C++, Python or comparable languages)
Experience with software‑hardware interaction and machine control software
Familiarity with structured software development processes, testing, and documentation
Understanding of software architecture principles and best practices
Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to colleagues, stakeholders, and customers
Strong collaborative mindset and willingness to support and mentor others

Work Requirements

Compliance with all relevant HID Global policies and procedures related to Quality, Security, Safety, Business Continuity, and Environmental systems.
Travel and fieldwork, including international travel may be required. Therefore, employee must possess, or be able to acquire a valid passport.
Must be legally eligible to work in the country in which you are hired.

What we can offer you:

A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture
Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential
To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds

Why apply?

Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply
Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers
Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted

HID does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

HID is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Our goal is to create a workplace that empowers everyone to thrive and be their authentic selves, fostering an environment of mutual respect and inclusivity. If you have a disability and require assistance or accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform essential job functions, please contact accommodations-ext@hidglobal.com.

At times, HID may use AI-assisted technology to help our Talent Acquisition team review applications by identifying job-related qualifications, skills, and experience in résumés and comparing them with the requirements of the role. The technology supports recruiter review but does not make hiring decisions. A member of our Talent Acquisition team reviews each application before any selection decision is made. Information processed by the tool is deleted once the recruiter's review is complete.

We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!

On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.

When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

Jouw rol gaat verder dan alleen adviseren; je leidt en voert ook actief projecten uit met behulp van de nieuwste Azure-tools en technologieën.

Bij Info Support werk je als Azure Cloud Architect in een omgeving waar innovatie, kennisdeling en groei centraal staan. Hier blijf jij je expertise ontwikkelen en til jij jouw skills naar een hoger niveau.

jobs.title: Hbo-meewerkstage ICT software development
jobs.description:
Ben jij een HBO-ICT student met interesse in softwareontwikkeling? Wil je ervaren hoe het is om deel uit te maken van een professioneel ontwikkelteam én bijdragen aan applicaties en systemen die dagelijks door miljoenen burgers en bedrijven worden gebruikt? Dan is deze meewerkstage iets voor jou. Een stage met maatschappelijke impact en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Meer details

Match criteria

Opleidingsniveau

HBO bachelor

Stage type

Meewerkstage
Praktijkopdracht

Functieomschrijving

Dit doe je bij de Belastingdienst

Tijdens deze stage werk je mee in een Agile Scrumteam waarin samenwerken, leren en ontwikkelen centraal staan. Je doet praktijkervaring op met softwareontwikkeling, moderne cloud-native technologieën en het werken volgens Agile- en DevOps-principes. Samen met developers, testers en andere IT-professionals werk je aan de modernisering van de dienstverlening van de Belastingdienst.

Je Ontwikkelt, Bouwt, Test En Verbetert Applicaties En Systemen Voor Verschillende Belastingmiddelen En Interne Processen. Daarmee Ondersteun Je Burgers, Bedrijven En Collega's Bij Hun Dagelijkse Werkzaamheden. Je Kunt Bijvoorbeeld Aan De Slag Met

het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en verbeteren van Java- en .NET-applicaties;
het automatiseren van beheer- en infrastructuurprocessen;
het realiseren van nieuwe functionaliteiten en oplossingen;
het optimaliseren van bestaande systemen en diensten;
het bouwen en verbeteren van mobiele toepassingen.

Je leert werken in een Agile team volgens Scrum en SAFe methodiek. Daarbij maak je gebruik van tools zoals Jira en Confluence en neem je actief deel aan scrum-events. Ook doe je ervaring op met DevOps-werkwijzen en maak je kennis met platformen zoals OpenShift.

Je staat er niet alleen voor. Ervaren collega's begeleiden je tijdens je stage en helpen je bij het behalen van je leerdoelen. Daarnaast kun je aansluiten bij bijeenkomsten, zodat je een goed beeld krijgt van het werken binnen de directie Informatievoorziening van de Belastingdienst. Je gaat veel leren, krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en zij leren ook van jou. Met jouw frisse blik en nieuwe inzichten help je de Belastindienst hun informatievoorziening verder te verbeteren.

Wil jij jezelf ontwikkelen tot IT-professional en ervaring opdoen binnen een Agile DevOps-team? Vertel ze in je motivatiebrief welke onderwerpen jou aanspreken, wat je graag wilt leren en welke IT-kennis en vaardigheden je al meebrengt. De exacte invulling van je stage bepalen zij samen met jou.

Wil je meer weten over het expertisegebied Development? Kijk dan op: https://werken.belastingdienst.nl/expertises/ict

Een bijzondere baan, omdat...

je ervaring opdoet met softwareontwikkeling in een grote en complexe ICT-omgeving.
je jezelf ontwikkelt op gebied van softwareontwikkeling, Agile en DevOps.
je volop ruimte krijgt voor persoonlijke en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling.
je deelneemt aan bijeenkomsten van vakgroepen en communities.
je kennismaakt met Jong IT Belastingdienst.
je samenwerkt met ervaren IT-professionals.
je professionele begeleiding krijgt bij het behalen van je leerdoelen.
je in overleg deels vanuit huis kunt werken.

Functievereisten

Je zit in het derde jaar van je HBO-ICT opleiding met focus op Software Development.
Je hebt interesse in Agile- en DevOps-werkwijzen.
Je nieuwsgiering bent naar cloud-native technologieën zoals OpenShift.
Je werkt graag samen, kunt zelfstandig werken en schakelt makkelijk met collega's.
Je hebt voldoende studiepunten behaald om aan deze stage te beginnen.
Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands.

Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden

€800
Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd
40 uur

Bijzonderheden

Deze stagevacature wordt gesloten zodra een geschikte student is geselecteerd. Wacht dus niet te lang met reageren.

Om stage te lopen bij de Belastingdienst, moet je een stageovereenkomst en geheimhoudingsverklaring ondertekenen en een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) overhandigen. De stagiair en de onderwijsinstelling moeten de in de stageovereenkomst vastgestelde geheimhoudingsplicht in acht nemen.

De belastingdienst ontvangt graag je motivatiebrief en cv in een Word-, Excel- of Pdf-bestand; na sluitingsdatum is het niet mogelijk om jouw sollicitatie in behandeling te nemen.

Jouw sollicitatie wordt alleen in behandeling genomen als je reageert via de daarvoor bestemde sollicitatiebutton en alle benodigde documenten zijn toegevoegd.

Vermeld In Je Motivatiebrief Duidelijk

De begin- en einddatum van jouw stage.
Het aantal uur per week dat je beschikbaar bent.
Wat je leerdoelen en interesses zijn, welke (IT) kennis en vaardigheden je hebt en waarom deze stagevacature je aanspreekt.

Als je al eerder stage gelopen hebt bij de Belastingdienst, vermeld dan ook de naam van je toenmalige stagebegeleider.

Solliciteren?

Dit kan via Werken voor Nederland. Vermeld in je sollicitatiebrief dat je bent doorverwezen door Rijks I-Stage.

Over de afdeling

Bij de Belastingdienst werken ongeveer 28.000 mensen verspreid over het hele land aan een financieel gezond Nederland. Dit doen ze door eerlijk en zorgvuldig belastingen en premies volksverzekeringen te heffen, te innen en te controleren en fraude op te sporen. De Belastingdienst maakt het burgers en bedrijven zo gemakkelijk mogelijk om verplichtingen na te kunnen komen en gebruik te kunnen maken van rechten. Dat gebeurt met passende dienstverlening, door massale processen juist en tijdig uit te voeren én door adequaat toezicht uit te oefenen. De Belastingdienst is sterk in ontwikkeling en heeft de ambitie om de beste Belastingdienst voor Nederland te zijn met focus op fiscale taken en vakmanschap. Lees meer over de Belastingdienst op: https://over-ons.belastingdienst.nl

jobs.title: Cloud Azure Architect
jobs.description:
Azure Cloud Architect bij Sogeti

Wij zijn op zoek naar twee ervaren Azure Cloud Architecten. Door een aantal mooie opdrachten bij de semi-overheid en in de utilities sector, zijn wij naarstig op zoek naar jou kennis en vooral ervaring. Jouw werk bestaat uit het ontwerpen van de Azure Cloudoplossingen en het ondersteunen bij de implementatie hiervan. Dit doen wij vanuit ons Cloud Competence Center van waaruit wij onze cloudklanten ondersteunen.

Jouw rol als Azure Cloud Architect

Als Azure Cloud Architect bij Sogeti ontwerp je schaalbare en veilige Microsoft Azure-architecturen. Je richt Landing Zones in, inclusief security. Daarnaast adviseer je organisaties over cloudmigraties en applicatiemodernisering.

Je werkt nauw samen met DevOps-teams om automation en CI/CD-pipelines te implementeren. Ook integreer je containerplatforms zoals AKS en serverless services. Verder zorg je voor monitoring en observability.

In jouw rol begeleid je architectuursessies en stakeholderworkshops, waarbij je concepten helder weet over te brengen en organisaties helpt hun cloudstrategie te realiseren.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent een ervaren Azure Cloud Architect met een passie voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve cloudoplossingen.
Je beschikt over HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als Cloud Architect, met een focus op Microsoft Azure.
Identity & Access Management, Infrastructure as Code (zoals ARM, Bicep of Terraform) en CI/CD-pipelines zijn voor jou bekende begrippen.
Je hebt ervaring met container orchestration en weet hoe je serverless oplossingen en API Management toepast.
Je bent bekend met architectuurframeworks zoals CAF, TOGAF en ArchiMate.
Certificeringen zoals AZ-305, AZ-104 en/of AZ-500 zijn een sterke bevestiging van jouw expertise.

Dit bieden wij jou

   Een dienstverband van 40 uur per week, met flexibele mogelijkheden om parttime te werken.
Een salaris tussen de € 75.000 en € 95.000 bruto per jaar (inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsbudget) plus 10% bonus voor 40 uur per week.
   Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, met o.a. opties om elektrisch te rijden.
   Hybride werken en een goede werk-privébalans.
   Uitgebreide opleidings- en certificeringsmogelijkheden.
   Flexibiliteit in het ruilen van feestdagen, passend bij jouw persoonlijke voorkeuren.
   26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de optie om extra dagen bij te kopen.
   Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties waarin jouw technische expertise het verschil maakt.
   Toegang tot onze kenniscommunity, meet-ups, hackathons en tech-events. En natuurlijk: ontspanning via game nights, skitrips en meer.

Ben jij nieuwsgierig geworden naar de projecten waar wij dagelijks aan werken en wil jij deel uitmaken van onze actieve Microsoft Community?

Solliciteer nu en ontdek hoe jij het verschil kunt maken!

Een PES-screening en assessment maken deel uit van het proces.

Je werkt nauw samen met DevOps-teams om automation en CI/CD-pipelines te implementeren. Ook integreer je containerplatforms zoals AKS en serverless services. Verder zorg je voor monitoring en observability.

Je hebt ervaring met container orchestration en weet hoe je serverless oplossingen en API Management toepast.

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage Validate MCPS platform deployments
jobs.description:
Een betrouwbare cloudomgeving vraagt om slimme validatie en continu inzicht. In deze opdracht breid je ons deploymentproces uit met innovatieve controles die direct na uitrol de werking en stabiliteit van Azure-platformen bevestigen. Zo versterk je de monitoring op ‘drift’ en afwijkingen en bouw je mee aan een toekomstvast, foutbestendig platformlandschap.

Veel organisaties gebruiken geautomatiseerde deployment pipelines voor het uitrollen van platformen in de cloud, vaak met tools als Kubernetes, Helm, Bicep en ArgoCD. Hoewel deze processen technisch betrouwbaar zijn, ontbreekt vaak een automatische controle op de functionele werking van het platform na een deployment. Om de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van platformuitrol te verbeteren, is het waardevol om aanvullende validatie- en consistentiecontroles toe te voegen. Daarmee ontstaat beter inzicht in de impact van wijzigingen en updates. Ook maakt het detecteren van ‘drift’ het mogelijk om sneller bij te sturen en de stabiliteit te vergroten.

De opdracht

Ontwikkel een methode om Azure-platformen na deployment te valideren en te controleren op consistentie met de beoogde configuratie. Denk hierbij aan het testen van de werking van individuele resources, het detecteren van afwijkingen (‘drift’) en het veilig uitvoeren van deze controles zonder impact op klantomgevingen.Je onderzoekt:

Hoe je kunt bepalen of Azure-resources juist zijn aangemaakt op basis van Helm-configuratie en het resultaat van de deployments.
Hoe je kunt vaststellen of deze resources correct functioneren.
Hoe je afwijkingen detecteert, zoals resources die niet (meer) in de configuratie staan.
Hoe je teams automatisch kunt waarschuwen bij afwijkingen.
Welke tooling en technieken geschikt zijn.

Je levert een proof of concept op dat naadloos integreert in het bestaande deploymentproces. Zo draag je bij aan nog betrouwbaarder, foutbestendiger en toekomstvast platformbeheer.

Over Info Support

Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst.

De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan.

Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden.

Om deze opdracht te kunnen doen is B2-taalvaardigheid in het Nederlands vereist.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer Managed Services
jobs.description:
Wil jij bouwen aan veilige, schaalbare en volledig geautomatiseerde cloudomgevingen voor toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland? Als Cloud Engineer bij Info Support werk je in een multidisciplinair team aan de cloudfundamenten van onze klanten. Je ontwikkelt en beheert moderne platformomgevingen in Microsoft Azure, AWS én onze eigen soevereine cloud in Nederland, met een sterke focus op security, automatisering en betrouwbaarheid. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig keuzes te maken, klanten te adviseren en technische innovaties door te voeren.

Wat ga je doen?

Ontwikkelen en beheren van cloudinfrastructuren in Microsoft Azure, AWS en onze Nederlandse soevereine cloud, met behulp van Infrastructure as Code.
Meebouwen aan gestandaardiseerde landing zones, inclusief netwerkarchitectuur, identity & access management, monitoring en security controls.
Werken met moderne cloud-native technologieën zoals Kubernetes, Prometheus, EntraID en API Management.
Ontwerpen en configureren van complexe netwerkstructuren, virtuele netwerken, firewalls en application gateways.
Je versterkt de core-infrastructuur van onze klanten door kritieke systemen te analyseren, moderniseren en optimaliseren, en adviseert actief over verbeteringen om de omgeving van de klant toekomstbestendig te maken.
Automatiseren van provisioning, updates en compliancecontroles via CI/CD- en GitOps-pipelines.
Actief adviseren van klanten over schaalbaarheid, beveiliging, netwerkconnectiviteit en beschikbaarheid, en fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt.
Nauw samenwerken met ons Security Operations Center (SOC) bij detectie en respons op beveiligingsincidenten.
Bijdragen aan de roadmap van onze clouddiensten en initiatieven voor verbetering van onze eigen cloudpropositie.

Dit breng je mee

Diepgaande kennis van Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform ) en ervaring in het opzetten van herhaalbare, schaalbare infrastructuren.
Ervaring met containerisatie en orkestratie (Docker, Kubernetes) in productieomgevingen.
Sterk inzicht in identity & access management, netwerkarchitecturen en cloudbeveiliging, gevirtualiseerde omgevingen, en ervaring met het toepassen hiervan in complexe klantomgevingen.

Bachelor of universitaire master in IT.

Je voelt je comfortabel in een adviserende rol richting collega’s en klanten en draagt actief bij aan vernieuwing en verbetering van processen en infrastructuren. Wat biedt Info Support jou?

Uiteraard bieden we je een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden met verschillende keuzemogelijkheden. Denk hierbij aan:

Vakantiegeld, winstuitkering, onkostenvergoeding, bijdrage pensioen

Bepaal zelf hoe je je werk indeelt en krijg de vrijheid om je eigen ideeën uit te voeren.

jobs.description:
Nie wieder langweilige Programmierarbeiten - Traumjob als IT Softwareentwickler/in
für alle, die sich gerne in die Entwicklung der Softwarearchitektur einbringen, diese programmieren und fehlerfrei testen möchten – gemeinsam in einem wertschätzenden Team bei flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

Du möchtest gerne die Familie, Deine Freizeit und Deinen Traumberuf unter einen Hut bekommen, ohne einen Spagat hinlegen zu müssen?  

Du wünschst Dir flexible Arbeitszeiten, damit Du dem gerecht werden kannst?  

Zudem wünschst Du Dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Du ganz Du selbst sein kannst, mit einem starken Team und wertschätzenden Chefs im Rücken?  

Auf Aufgaben, die Deinen Stärken nicht entsprechen, hast Du keine Lust mehr?

Dann solltest Du jetzt unbedingt weiterlesen.

Denn wir bei Artschwager + Kohl
bieten Dir genau das, was Du Dir als IT Softwareentwickler wünschst: Einen Arbeitsplatz, der Dich nicht mehr in Terminstress bringt, ein familiäres Team
, in dem sich alle gegenseitig unterstützen und Aufgaben, bei denen Du nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen wirst.

Welche Aufgaben Dich erwarten, welche Vorteile wir sonst noch bieten und wen wir uns für diese Stelle wünschen, erfährst Du in dieser Stellenanzeige.

Aufgaben

Diese strukturierten Aufgaben warten auf Dich

Als IT Softwareentwickler bist Du ein sehr wichtiger Teil unseres Teams, denn dies sind Deine Aufgaben:

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team und dem Lead die erforderliche Softwarearchitektur für Logistikprojekte in Produktionsbetrieben
. Logistikprojekte ähneln sich grundsätzlich, sind aber dennoch immer unterschiedlich. Dadurch kannst Du Deine Erfahrungen für ähnliche Wiederholungsprojekte sehr gut einbringen. Es kommt aber dennoch nie Langeweile auf, da jedes Projekt doch anders ist und dies Deine Kreativität als Softwarespezialist fordern wird.

Du arbeitest mit an der Dokumentation
der erarbeiteten Softwarearchitektur. Wir nutzen dazu MS Word, Excel, Visio.

Du programmierst Arbeitspakete wie z. B. Kommunikationsmodule zu SAP oder D365, Warehouse Controller zur Lagersteuerung, Controller für Regalbediengeräte, Fördertechnik, Transportroboter, Web-Apps oder Mobile Apps. Hierbei beginnst Du nicht bei NULL zu programmieren, sondern nutzt geeignete Module unseres Frameworks LOMAS
.

Du testest
die von Dir erstellten Module gegen digitale Zwillinge
vollständig durch.

Du führst gemeinsam mit dem Team einen vollständigen Integrationstest
des kompletten Systems durch. Auch hierbei wirst Du digitale Zwillinge nutzen, manchmal als Software-in-the-loop, manchmal als Hardware-in-the-loop Lösungen.

Du installierst die Software remote auf den Servern der Produktionsbetriebe und testest remote alle Schnittstellen mit den Koppelpartnern durch.

Du nimmst die installierte Software remote in Betrieb. Manchmal ist es erforderlich, zur Fabrik des Kunden zu reisen und die Software vor Ort in Betrieb zu nehmen.

Wenn Du genügend Erfahrung hast, unterstützt Du die Anwender bei der Behebung technischer Probleme.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

Es ist uns nicht so wichtig, wenn es Dir eher schwerfällt, Dich durchzusetzen. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass Du empathisch bist und strukturiert arbeitest
. Ferner erfüllst Du folgende Voraussetzungen:

Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung / Studium
im Bereich IT Softwareentwicklung und mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung.

Du kennst Dich mit den gängigsten Microsoft-Programmen (Visual Studio, DevOps, SubVersion, Tortoise, GitHub, Word, Excel, Powerpoint) gut aus, da Du bereits seit einigen Jahren damit arbeitest.

Du hast Routine im Umgang mit dem TechStack C#.net, MS SQL, ASP.net, Angular, MAUI

Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in der Entwicklung von Kommunikationsdiensten, gespeicherten Prozeduren in TSQL, UI Entwicklung mit ASP.NET, Angular, MAUI.

Die Suche nach Deinen eigenen Programmierfehlern ist für Dich keine Last, sondern Ansporn auch den letzten Bug zu finden und zu eliminieren
. Du liebst sauber strukturierten und fehlerfreien Code.

Du magst es gemeinsam mit dem Team und dem Projektleiter eine saubere System- und Softwarearchitektur
zu erarbeiten und diese zu dokumentieren.

Englisch schreibst und sprichst Du gut.

Deine Kollegen haben sich in der Vergangenheit schon häufiger bei Dir bedankt, da Du das Team bei Engpässen sehr gerne unterstützt. Außerdem freust Du Dich, wenn Du Kollegen helfen und ihnen bei softwarerelevanten Themen zur Seite stehen kannst.

Du bist sehr gewissenhaft und ordentlich
. So prüfst Du Deine Aufgaben gerne doppelt, um sicherzugehen, dass Dir kein Fehler unterlaufen ist.

Geduld
ist Deine Stärke, und das zeigst Du Deinen Chefs und Kollegen regelmäßig. Auch bei Änderungen und Rückfragen verlierst Du nie die Fassung und bist zugewandt, hilfsbereit und suchst immer nach Lösungen zum Erfolg des ganzen Teams.

Bewirb Dich nicht bei uns, wenn …

Du keine Lust hast gemeinsam im Team eine Softwarearchitektur zu entwickeln

Du nicht den Anspruch an Dich selbst hast, zuverlässige und fehlerfreie Software zu entwickeln

Du nicht bereit bist Deine Programmierfehler selbst zu suchen und zu fixen, sondern dies lieber anderen überlassen möchtest

Du kein Interesse hast, das Ergebnis Deiner Arbeit zu sehen und stolz darauf sein zu können

Dir das Wohl Deiner Kollegen egal ist und Du lieber auf Deinen eigenen Vorteil bedacht bist.

Du bei Kollegen und Chefs lieber auf Distanz bleibst, als einen freundschaftlichen Umgang zu pflegen.

Du Dich nicht mit Artschwager + Kohl identifizieren kannst und Dich bei jedem beliebigen Unternehmen bewerben würdest, da Dir vollkommen egal ist, für wen Du arbeitest.

Du nur auf der Durchreise bist und von vornherein kein Interesse an einer langfristigen Anstellung hast.

Du nicht bereit bist, Dich auch mal in neue Programme oder Aufgaben einzuarbeiten, die Dir langfristig den Arbeitsalltag erleichtern (keine Sorge, wir wissen, wie wichtig Dir Prozesse und Routinen sind, deshalb unterstützen wir Dich hier).

Es Dir schwerfällt, Ordnung zu halten.

Du nur einen Job suchst, der die Miete zahlt.

Benefits

Damit zeigen wir Dir unsere Wertschätzung

Bei uns musst Du Dich nicht zwischen Beruf und Familie zerreißen und mit unstrukturierten Aufgaben herumschlagen.

Außerdem erhältst du folgende Vorteile als IT Softwareentwickler:

Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Home Office
- Damit Du Deinen Alltag so strukturieren kannst, wie es für Dich am besten passt, bieten wir Dir flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen Deiner Beschäftigung. Zudem hast du auch die Möglichkeit Home Office zu machen.

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack software for a wide range of platforms and technologies.
Research, evaluate, and integrate new tools, frameworks, and methodologies to solve complex technical challenges.
Participate in the full software development life cycle from requirements gathering through deployment and maintenance.

Contribute ideas and insight to product development, not just implement specifications.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Two or more years of professional software development experience.
Strong object-oriented programming skills with proficiency in C# preferred.
Experience with database design, SQL, and backend development.
Experience in the IoT and/or home automation field is a plus.
Experience writing and maintaining unit tests.
A curious mindset and a desire to continuously learn and improve.

Collaborate with outstanding people: We have a strong focus on teamwork, and we work to create a collaborative and welcoming environment that enables our teams to excel.
Make an immediate impact: You can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You will be empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!

Long-term employment based on a permanent employment contract (CoE).

jobs.title: Platform Engineering Manager - Platform Shared Services
jobs.description:
About Frontiers

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

The Mission

At Frontiers, we are rewriting the rules of scientific publishing. Behind every product team sit the shared technical services the whole publishing platform depends on. Today these are Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Messaging (transactional email and GDPR-compliant consent) — examples of this kind of shared service, with more likely over time — owned by our Platform Shared Services team. We are looking for a Platform Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs them.

You will own team delivery, technical direction (in partnership with your Senior Engineers), and the people development of a team of [5-8] engineers. These are high-blast-radius services consumed org-wide, so you'll balance shipping new capability with reliability, security and backward compatibility — treating the services as products for internal engineering customers. You'll form a delivery triad with the team's Platform Product Manager (who owns the What/Why) and your Senior Engineers (who drive the How).

The Technical Context

You will lead delivery across the team's shared-service lines — today IAM and Messaging.

IAM: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC (Ory Hydra), JWT authorization, fine-grained authz via a Permission API (Ory Keto), Azure APIM, OAuth client tooling, shared .NET libraries
Messaging: transactional/outreach email at scale (SendGrid, Mailgun), templating and A/B testing, deliverability tooling, and a central GDPR consent authority (Subscription Management)
Core stack: C#/.NET services on Microsoft Azure + Kubernetes (AKS); event-driven with RabbitMQ and Kafka; SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch
Delivery & reliability: CI/CD, observability (New Relic, Grafana), SLAs/SLOs and incident management
Ways of working: Spec-Driven / AI-First Delivery (PRDs/SDDs in git, the Technology Framework as executable context, Cursor, MCP) — available to help the team deliver faster and more safely

What You'll Do

Lead the team day to day — oversee operations, resource allocation and task assignment across the IAM and Messaging portfolio
Turn roadmap into execution — translate the shared-services roadmap and portfolio objectives (owned with the Platform PM) into actionable engineering plans; ensure delivery aligns with department and wider engineering goals
Own team delivery — for authentication, messaging and related infrastructure: coordinate resources, manage risk, and deliver outcomes for the many teams that depend on these services
Partner with the Platform Product Manager — align roadmap priorities with technical feasibility, reliability and platform health; push back with technical reality where needed
Guide technical direction with your Senior Engineers — you don't need to be hands-on daily, but you provide enough depth to steer decisions on authentication and messaging infrastructure and to review architecture and design proposals
Develop people — set clear expectations, give regular feedback, support career growth, and run performance management for the team
Own reliability & operational excellence at the team level — SLAs/SLOs, incident management, and blameless post-incident follow-through; protect the team from unbounded toil
Improve process — identify and implement improvements that increase delivery efficiency and reliability across the team and portfolio
Represent the team cross-functionally — drive alignment with the engineering teams that consume shared services; escalate and manage significant technical/delivery risks to senior leadership

Requirements

Management experience: minimum 4 + years directly managing engineering teams, in addition to prior hands-on software engineering experience
Delivery track record: proven delivery of backend, platform, or infrastructure services; experience managing teams responsible for shared/platform services (authentication, messaging, APIs) strongly preferred
Technical depth (to steer, not to code daily): solid background in backend engineering and distributed systems — enough to guide decisions on authentication and messaging infrastructure and review design proposals with senior engineers
Reliability & delivery practices: working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and service reliability (SLAs/SLOs, incident management)
Platform / shared-services understanding: how internal engineering teams operate as service providers to the rest of the org
People & delivery balance: organised and outcome-driven, comfortable balancing people management (:60%) with technical/business activities (:40%)
Planning: budget/resource planning experience for a team
Communication & judgement: clear communicator across technical and non-technical stakeholders; sound decision-making and comfort resolving ambiguity
Language: Professional-level English (spoken and written)

Nice to Have

Hands-on background with authentication/identity (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT) and/or messaging/event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes (AKS), and .NET/C# environments
Familiarity with GDPR / consent and security/compliance as part of the delivery bar
Experience leading a team through a CI/CD or platform migration
Interest in Spec-Driven Development and enabling an AI-First delivery workflow for the team (Cursor, MCP, the Technology Framework)
Background in Scientific Publishing

How We Measure Success In This Role

Delivery: predictable, healthy throughput against the shared-services roadmap; risks surfaced and managed early
Reliability: SLAs/SLOs met for owned services; incident trend and quality of post-incident follow-through
People: team health, retention, growth and clear performance management
Consumer outcomes: satisfaction/adoption from the engineering teams that depend on IAM and Messaging
Security & compliance: the team's output meets the Technology Framework bar (OAuth/JWT, GDPR consent)

Why This Role Is Exciting

You'll lead the team behind two of Frontiers' highest-leverage capabilities: get identity and messaging right, and every product team ships faster and safer. It's a rare mix of real people leadership
, technical direction on interesting distributed systems
, and platform-as-a-product
thinking — all in service of a mission that matters: making science open for everyone.

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

Equal opportunity statement

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

jobs.title: Principal Architect (2489766)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a financial technology business that provides banks with the data intelligence behind personalised digital banking. Its platform runs in demanding client environments, with much of the estate currently deployed on-premises and an active migration towards cloud.

As Principal Architect, you'll own the architecture of the whole platform: services, data, integrations, deployment models and the boundaries between them. Reporting directly to the CTO, you'll set technical direction, make difficult trade-offs and remain accountable for whether the architecture supports the business as it scales.

The business is undertaking a funded platform transformation spanning performance, architecture and AI. This is not a review-and-advise position or a programme management role. You'll draft the target architecture, defend it with engineers and customers, and stay close to implementation so you can correct drift early. The work is about shaping the technical outcome while ensuring today's delivery remains consistent with the platform's longer-term direction.

The Role

Define and own the target architecture, establishing the platform structure and clear service boundaries that engineers can use to make implementation decisions.
Shape the technical transformation from on-premises to cloud, from MSSQL to PostgreSQL and from legacy systems to a coherent platform. Stay close enough to delivery to identify divergence before it becomes entrenched.
Document architectural decisions through RFCs, architecture decision records and technical strategy. Write clearly enough that teams can understand the rationale, resolve debates and act on the agreed direction.
Embed AI as a first-class architectural concern across services, data pipelines and the software development lifecycle, rather than treating it only as an additional feature.
Explain and defend the architecture with both internal engineers and bank-side architects, balancing technical credibility with clear communication about trade-offs.
Make decisions that work across on-premises client installations and cloud environments, maintaining practical awareness of both during the migration.

What We're Looking For

Ownership of a distributed, data-heavy platform architecture in production, with significant customer expectations. Designing a system in isolation is not enough; you should be able to explain how your decisions held up in operation.
Experience moving a live system from one architecture to another without stopping the business, with an honest account of the costs, compromises and lessons.
Deep C# and .NET knowledge, strong MSSQL and PostgreSQL experience, and practical exposure to both on-premises and cloud systems. You'll need to read implementation code critically, not operate solely at diagram level.
Hands-on understanding of Azure, Kafka, Kubernetes, Helm charts and distributed systems at scale.
Clear technical writing, demonstrated through RFCs, decision records or public technical communication. You should be able to turn an architectural judgement into an explicit, usable decision.
Credibility with engineers and customers, including bank architects who will challenge the proposed direction.
An active approach to reasoning about how AI changes architecture and engineering practice, including use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.

Relevant Desirable Experience

RabbitMQ, Terraform, GCP or Python.
Fintech or another regulated industry where technical decisions must work within demanding client constraints.

Working Environment

This is a B2B contract engagement with two office days and three remote days each week. The source lists equity participation through an employee share option programme, private healthcare and support for wellbeing and everyday working costs. The role combines a direct reporting line to the CTO with authority to set technical direction and accountability for the resulting architecture.

Interview Process

A 30-minute screening call covers transformations you've led and what you learned. A 60-minute CTO discussion explores architecture, trade-offs and change at scale. A 90-minute architecture deep-dive uses a real platform problem, with AI tools welcome. The employer states that a decision or offer follows within ten days of the final interview.

This could suit a principal or platform architect who has already led a live technical transformation and wants whole-platform ownership while remaining close to code, engineering decisions and customer requirements.

Stanowisko To Podlega

Innovation Enablement Manager

__

As a Sales Configurator Product Modeler / Developer you will be a member of a team developing and maintaining sales configurators solutions supporting the operations and customers of ABB Electrification (EL) - Distribution Solution (ELDS) and Service (ELSE). You will be working in a cross-functional team which operates in an international environment.

In this role you will be responsible for the modelling and maintenance of distribution systems and service products (switchgears, grid components and service offering ) in the new global ELDS/SE sales configurator platform(s). You will closely collaborate with product sales configurators, portfolio managers and engineers to design, implement, test and troubleshoot the product models. Together with the internal ABB IS and Business Teams you will have unique opportunity to learn the product portfolio and based on that design and deliver the future platform ensuring it meets the needs of our customers and sales team

The work model for the role is: #hybrid;

You Will Be Mainly Accountable For

Design, implement, test, and troubleshoot product models for ELDS and ELSE.
Develop the product models as defined by the Product Managers / Sales Configurators Portfolio Managers and Engineers. Ensure product models are well-structured to enable high quality change management and simplify the future maintenance
Collaborate with relevant IS and Business stakeholders to deliver a user-friendly and efficient Sales Configurator solution.
Work closely with the platform supplier / implementation partner to ensure the integrity of the product model is guaranteed as the platform evolves.
Provide technical support, troubleshooting and fixing issues reported by users.
Contribute to the overall sales configurator development process

Qualifications For The Role

You are highly skilled in product modelling and configuration within sales configurator tools and enjoy working in the industrial technology and engineering sector
You have established experience in the software development lifecycle, including working with tools such as Azure DevOps
You possess solid expertise in programming languages such as .NET, Python, Java, or similar technologies

jobs.title: Platform Product Manager - Platform Shared Services
jobs.description:
About Frontiers

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

The Mission

At Frontiers, we are rewriting the rules of scientific publishing. Behind every product team sit the shared technical services that the whole publishing platform depends on. Today these are Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Messaging (transactional email and GDPR-compliant consent) — representative examples of this kind of shared service, with the portfolio expected to grow over time. They are owned by our Platform Shared Services team, and we are looking for a Platform Product Manager to own their strategy and roadmap.

This is not an end-user product role. Your customers are Frontiers' own engineering teams (and, increasingly, the services and agents they build): you run IAM and Messaging as products, measured by adoption, developer experience, reliability, integration time, security posture and cost — not user-facing metrics. You'll form a delivery triad with the team's Platform Engineering Manager and Senior Engineers: you own the What and Why, they own the How.

The Technical Context

You will own the roadmap for the team's shared-service lines — today IAM and Messaging.

IAM: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC (Ory Hydra), JWT authorization, fine-grained authz via a Permission API (Ory Keto), Azure APIM at the edge, OAuth client tooling, shared .NET libraries
Messaging: transactional/outreach email at scale (SendGrid, Mailgun), templating and A/B testing, deliverability (Everest, Uriports, Postmaster, SNDS), and a central GDPR consent authority (Subscription Management)
Core stack: C#/.NET services on Microsoft Azure + Kubernetes (AKS); event-driven with RabbitMQ and Kafka; SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch
Contracts as the product: REST + async APIs, JWT shape and scopes, consent semantics, versioning and backward compatibility — high blast radius, consumed org-wide
Observability & AI: New Relic, Prometheus/Grafana; the sub-department's AI-First Delivery tooling (Cursor, MCP, the Technology Framework as executable context) is available to the team

What You'll Do

Own and evolve the roadmap for IAM and Messaging — prioritising against internal engineering demand, security/compliance requirements and platform scalability, and slicing big initiatives into iterative, valuable releases
Turn engineering needs into clear specs and a prioritised backlog — translate requirements from stream-aligned teams into well-shaped work (PRDs/SDDs in git, following our Spec-Driven / AI-First Delivery practice)
Co-design with engineering — work lock-step with the Platform Engineering Manager and Senior Engineers on architecture trade-offs, API contracts and service-level requirements. This needs genuine technical fluency, not just business↔engineering translation
Own the service/API lifecycle — versioning strategy, deprecation planning and backward-compatibility decisions for services many teams depend on
Be the primary point of contact for internal "customers" integrating with IAM and Messaging — a developer-facing product function: discovery, onboarding, support model, and a feedback loop that actually changes the roadmap
Define and track success metrics — adoption by internal teams, reliability (SLAs/SLOs), integration/time-to-first-call, security posture, and cost
Partner with Security, Architecture and Infrastructure — ensure IAM and Messaging meet compliance and security standards (OAuth/JWT, GDPR consent) and stay aligned with the Technology Framework
Communicate roadmap, trade-offs and priorities clearly to engineering leadership and stakeholder teams — manage expectations transparently, including a tactful, well-reasoned "not now"

Requirements

Experience: 5+ years in Technical / Platform Product Management or engineering leadership, a significant portion in technical, platform, or developer-facing product roles
Platform-as-a-product mindset: you build for internal engineering customers, not end users, and can prioritize a technical roadmap against competing engineering demands
Technical fluency (real): solid software-engineering fundamentals — enough to engage credibly in architecture discussions, read technical docs, system diagrams and API specs unaided, and reason about trade-offs
APIs as products: strong grasp of API design, versioning, documentation and lifecycle management (deprecation, backward compatibility)
Distributed-systems literacy: working knowledge of backend systems, messaging/event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS) and authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT)
Reliability & cloud awareness: SLAs/SLOs, uptime, latency; familiarity with cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP)
Education/background: Bachelor's in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical/technical experience — a technical/engineering background is preferred over a pure business/PM background given the hard technical requirements
Language: Professional-level English (spoken and written).

Nice to Have

Demonstrated experience with authentication and/or messaging systems (strongly preferred)
Familiarity with GDPR / consent and email deliverability at scale
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes (AKS), and modern CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
Experience facilitating InnerSource or community-driven contributions to shared services
Interest or experience in Spec-Driven Development and AI coding assistants (Cursor, MCP)
Background in Scientific Publishing

How We Measure Success In This Role

Adoption & integration: number of teams/services on the supported IAM and Messaging paths; time-to-first-call for a new integration
Reliability: SLAs/SLOs met for the owned services; incident trend
Developer experience: internal satisfaction/NPS of consuming teams; support-request trend; quality and currency of contracts and docs
Security & compliance: posture against the Technology Framework (OAuth/JWT, GDPR consent); audit-readiness
Cost: run cost of the services (incl. email/deliverability spend) under control

Why This Role Is Exciting

IAM and Messaging are leverage
: get them right and every team at Frontiers ships faster and safer. You'll turn "plumbing" into genuine products — with real customers, contracts and adoption — at the exact moment AI is multiplying how much code (and how many integrations) those teams produce. All in service of a mission that matters: making science open for everyone.

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

Equal opportunity statement

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Network Capacity management Services
jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we run one of the largest networks in the world supporting the AWS Cloud globally. In order to manage this unimaginable scale, we are driving revolutionary changes to the way networks are conceived, designed, built and operated. We put services and algorithms in place to control and manage all layers of the Amazon network, from top of the rack switches (TORs) to our internet and private backbone facing routers. This software ecosystem must be intelligent, scalable and fault tolerant. Our vision is to ultimately have self-managed networks and our Network Lifecycle Management (NLM) organization is responsible for building key services that will enable this vision.

We are establishing a team of engineers that would build a set of foundational network services that form a core part of our Software Defined Networking (SDN) ecosystem. The main focus of the team will be to design and own a closed-loop system for the reservation of network entities associated to procurement activities. This service is vital for closing the gap between network capacity planning and our network automation systems. It is a crucial step towards our vision of a truly self-managed and adaptive network.

We are looking for talented software engineers who want to get hands on experience with fully automated hyperscale data center networks, cloud infrastructure, large-scale software deployments, algorithms, distributed systems and service-oriented architectures (SOA). This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced and new Software Development Engineers wanting to solve some of the hard problems associated with config generation, modeling and storage at a large scale. No prior Networking experience required. In fact, we are looking for members with strong software services background to spearhead development of highly reliable scalable services.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

As Member Of The Team You Will

Design and develop highly scalable and reliable services that manage network configuration lifecycle.
Work with peers, customers and partner engineering teams to develop state of the art solutions, incorporating new technologies, algorithms and innovations.
Build technical roadmap to evolve our software services space
Above all build a solid career path with an exponential learning curve, while having fun and making history!

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

jobs.title: Data Platform DevOps Analyst
jobs.description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively seeking for Data Ops Analyst to join its Data Platform & Engineering team, supporting the reliability and performance of its Databricks-based enterprise data platform. The role focuses on monitoring data pipelines, managing incidents, coordinating releases and production handovers, and ensuring data products are well-governed, scalable, and operationally ready. Working closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, you'll play a key role in delivering trusted data solutions while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Get

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as
Data Ops Analyst

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:

Support the operation and reliability of Primark’s modern data platform helping manage Databricks, dbt Cloud and Azure data services while ensuring data products are production-ready, supportable and aligned with engineering standards.
Monitor and maintain critical data pipelines and platform services proactively identifying failures, delays, data quality issues and operational risks while coordinating incident triage, escalation and resolution to minimise business impact.
Coordinate releases, deployments and production handovers managing environment readiness, promotion activities, change governance, operational checklists, release schedules and service readiness documentation to ensure smooth delivery.
Drive operational excellence through governance and documentation maintaining runbooks, support guides, monitoring dashboards, service catalogues and reporting on platform health, SLA performance, deployment activity and support trends.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Platform, Cloud, Security, BAU and SIAM teams supporting access management, environment support, platform issue resolution, service reviews and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability and supportability.
Contribute to Primark’s data platform modernisation journey supporting the migration from Teradata to Databricks, validating production readiness, improving monitoring and automation capabilities and helping embed modern DataOps practices across deployment, observability and support processes.

What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

2-4 years’ experience in Data Operations, Application Support, Platform Support, Data Engineering Support or a similar operational role supporting business-critical systems and data platforms in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of modern data platforms and DataOps practices with exposure to Azure DevOps, Databricks, dbt Cloud, Azure data services, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT processes, job scheduling, monitoring, observability and deployment automation.
Experience supporting production environments and service operations including monitoring, alerting, incident management, ticketing systems, release management, environment management, change governance and enterprise support processes.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate incidents methodically, identify root causes, assess business impact and drive issues through to resolution while maintaining high operational standards.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, Governance, SIAM, Analytics and business teams while clearly communicating technical issues and recommended actions.
Proactive, detail-oriented and continuous improvement focused with experience maintaining operational documentation, runbooks, handover materials and support processes while identifying opportunities to improve reliability, reduce recurring issues, increase automation and enhance overall platform supportability.

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing.

So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.

You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

jobs.title: Er du vår neste løsningsarkitekt på Power Platform/Dynamics 365?
jobs.description:
Bouvet har et av Norges ledende miljøer innen Power Platform med over 200 konsulenter, og vi skal bli flere. Vi satser videre på lavkode, og ser nå etter kloke hoder som kan bistå med å bygge fremtidens samfunn sammen med viktige og samfunnskritiske kunder.

Vi søker deg som har teknisk erfaring med Power Platform eller Dynamics 365, liker å være tett på kunden og gi dem gode råd. Du har god kontroll på det tekniske, men trives også med å jobbe strategisk og funksjonelt i tett samarbeid med andre fagområder. Vi er opptatt av å levere løsninger av høy kvalitet som løser kundens problemstillinger på en god måte, og evne til å sette seg inn i kunden forretning er derfor viktig i denne rollen.

I rollen kan du ha følgende ansvarsområder:

Teknisk ansvar i leveranser hos våre kunder
Kartlegge og analysere forretningsbehov for deretter å oversette disse til tekniske løsninger
Planlegge, utvikle og implementere løsninger sammen med resten av teamet
Være en støttespiller for kundene og gi de gode råd om bruk av plattformen
Følge med utviklingen innenfor Power Platform og sikre at vi informerer kunde om nye muligheter i plattformen

Dette vil du løse med glans om du kjenner deg igjen i noen av disse kvalifikasjonene:

Du bør ha gode tekniske ferdigheter i Power Platform eller Dynamics 365
Du har flere års erfaring med Power Platform eller Dynamics 365
God oversikt over Dataverse og kjennskap til plattformen som helhet
Du er opptatt av å levere brukerorienterte løsninger i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi og forretning
Du ønsker å bidra i et fagmiljø og dele kunnskap med andre

Det er også fint om du har:

Kjennskap til Microsoft 365, Microsoft Fabric og/eller Microsoft Azure
Relevante sertifiseringer innen Power Platform eller Dynamics 365, for eksempel PL-600
Erfaring med prototyping, brukertesting og oppsett av skisser
Du har en IT-relatert universitets- eller høyskoleutdannelse eller relevant erfaring

Her er utvalg av våre gulrøtter som du får hos oss:

🥕 Du får din egen utviklingsplan. Hos oss vil du få god oppfølgning og muligheten til å fordype deg på og bevege deg mellom fagfelt, bransjer og roller.

🥕 Hos oss får du oppgaver som er faglig utfordrende, i prosjekter som veldig ofte påvirker langt flere enn oppdragsgiveren.

🥕 Du får ha et liv utenfor jobben. Frihet og fritid er viktige verdier hos oss. Du får tilpasse hverdagen din etter dine behov.

🥕 Alle får bonus. Prestasjonsbasert lønn og individuelle bonuser er ikke noe for oss. Vi gir deg trygghet med fast lønn og overskuddsdeling (bonusordning), og du får selvsagt betalt for overtid i perioder du må stå på litt ekstra. Vi har selvfølgelig mange flere gulrøtter. De finner du i vår Gulrotindeks her🥕

Bli med oss når vi går foran og bygger fremtidens samfunn

Hvis beskrivelsen her passer deg, så send oss en søknad og CV. Vil du høre mer om alle mulighetene i Bouvet så ta gjerne kontakt eller kom innom vårt kontor for en kaffeprat.

Etter ansettelse vil en tredje parts bakgrunnssjekk gjennomføres. Dette er en verifisering av de opplysninger som gis i rekrutteringsprosessen. Bakgrunnssjekken er tilpasset stillingens krav og gjennomføres etter søkerens samtykke.

jobs.title: AI-Driven Data Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on Data Architect
who thrives in an AI-first world – designing modern data platforms, leveraging AI-driven development
, and shaping how organizations turn data into intelligent action? Do you combine strong data engineering foundations with a software engineering mindset, and enjoy building, not just designing?

Here at Nortal, you will play a key role in shaping and advancing our data expertise and designing solutions
for our clients in Europe. You will work alongside top professionals in data and AI development
in Finland, collaborating with global data and software teams to design impactful solutions that drive business value.

What You'll Do

Design and implement AI-enabled data architectures and solutions on modern lakehouse platforms (Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks)
Apply AI-assisted and agent-driven design and development approaches to accelerate data platform and data product delivery
Combine data engineering, software engineering and DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD, testing, versioning, modular design)
Define and enforce data strategy, governance, standards and architectural guidelines
Work closely with technical and business teams to ensure alignment
Nurture a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing
Support pre-sales and solution design, contributing to customer engagements and proposals.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Experience in designing data architecture as part of enterprise architecture and data strategy
Familiarity with data mesh paradigm and principles
Knowledge of various data architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, and lakehouses
Experience with cloud and on-premise data solutions using Microsoft technologies, including strong hands-on work with Microsoft Fabric (preferred) or Databricks lakehouse platforms
Hands-on experience and/or strong understanding of working with agentic AI development and software delivery methodologies, e.g. agentic swarm coding and spec-driven development.
Experience applying software engineering practices (e.g. version control, CI/CD, testing) in data environments
Experience on hands-on software engineering & general software architecture design is a big plus
Pre-GenAI proficiency in Python and SQL
Fluent in both Finnish and English

We value the following certifications

Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer Associate
Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
Databricks Data Engineer Associate or Professional
Azure Solutions Architect Expert

Why join Nortal?

We value individuals not just for their skills, but also for their cultural alignment. Our core values include a commitment to delivering value and results, taking ownership, empowering oneself and others, and owning your future and growth. In addition to our professionalism, we appreciate a touch of good humor!
We prioritize your growth and development. At Nortal, we actively support constant improvement and knowledge sharing through our Capability teams, both internal and external training opportunities, self-learning, a mentorship program, and strong 1:1 culture.
We prioritize your health and well-being by offering a flexible range of benefits, including adaptable working hours, access to high-quality occupational healthcare, massage services, and bicycle benefit. We are also a remote friendly company.

Nortal’s offices are located in Helsinki, Turku, Oulu, Uusikaupunki, and Jyväskylä. This position can be worked from any of the previous, but we are pretty flexible with remote work as well.

Interested?
