Job Description

Tule mukaan Tieto Tech Consulting -tiimiin kasvamaan ympäristössä, jossa teknologia, liiketoimintamuotoilu ja yhteiskunnallinen vaikuttavuus kohtaavat.

Etsimme nyt Power Platform Developeria
tiimiin, jossa tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa ja merkityksellisissä projekteissa, jotka muovaavat toimialoja ja parantavat ihmisten arkea.

Mikä on Tech Consulting?

Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen osaamisen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen parhaat käytännöt.

Uskomme yhteistyöhön, avoimuuteen ja siihen, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät erilaisten ihmisten ja ajatusten kohdatessa.

Asiakkainamme on yli 130 organisaatiota eri toimialoilta, kuten julkishallinto, finanssi-, eläke-, energia-, logistiikka- ja valmistava teollisuus. Kehitämme digitaalisia palveluita, joita ihmiset käyttävät päivittäin – ratkaisuja, joilla on todellista vaikutusta arkeen ja yhteiskuntaan.

Mitä tulet tekemään tässä roolissa?

Tässä roolissa yrittäjähenkisyys ja oma-aloitteisuus ovat avainasemassa. Pääset rakentamaan roolistasi omanlaisesi osana tiimiämme, ja painopisteesi voi olla esimerkiksi myynnin tukemisessa, asiakasdialogissa, teknisten ratkaisujen määrittelyssä, backlogien jalostamisessa tai jatkuvan parantamisen edistämisessä.

Työskentelemme usein funktioittain asiakkaiden sijaan, ja odotamme sinulta uusia näkökulmia sekä halua kehittää toimintatapojamme. Asiakastyössä autat ohjaamaan keskustelua pitkäjänteisen ja ketterän tuotekehityksen suuntaan sen sijaan, että keskityttäisiin pelkästään aikataulukysymyksiin.

Liityt tiimiin, jossa osaamisen jakaminen, yhteistyö ja asiakkaista huolehtiminen ovat vahvasti läsnä. Näkemystäsi arvostetaan, ja toivomme sinun olevan tärkeä osa yhteistä menestystämme!

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vähintään 2 vuoden kokemus Microsoft Power Platform -ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta
Vahva osaaminen Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, Copilot Studio)
Dynamics 365 -kokemus katsotaan eduksi
Power Platform / Dynamics -sertifikaatit plussaa
Kokemusta .NET- ja/tai React-kehityksestä sekä integraatioista
Kokemusta Azure Functions- ja Logic Apps -ratkaisuista sekä DevOps-ympäristöistä
Kokemusta tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä kehityksessä ja asiakasratkaisuissa
Hyvät viestintätaidot ja kyky selittää teknisiä ratkaisuja ei-teknisille sidosryhmille
Sujuva suomi ja englanti
Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tietojenkäsittely, ohjelmistotekniikka)

Miksi liittyä kasvavaan tiimiimme?

Tiedolla rakennamme teknologiaa, joka toimii ihmisten hyväksi. Tech Consultingissa työskentelet teknologian, innovaation ja yhteiskunnallisen vaikuttavuuden rajapinnassa.

Saat tueksesi Suomen laajimman IT-osaajaverkoston sekä kulttuurin, joka kannustaa yhteistyöhön, uteliaisuuteen ja jatkuvaan oppimiseen. Meillä kasvu ei pysähdy.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Merkityksellistä työtä yhteiskunnallisesti kriittisten digitaalisten ratkaisujen parissa
Pohjoismaisen, vastuullisen ja luottamukseen perustuvan työyhteisön
Mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi eri toimialoilla, teknologioissa ja rooleissa
Joustavat työskentelytavat, hyvinvointia tukevat edut sekä inhimillisen työkulttuurin

Miten haet mukaan?

Lähetä hakemuksesi urasivujemme kautta ja tule mukaan rakentamaan Microsoft-ratkaisujen tulevaisuutta eri toimialoilla!

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele hakemuksia heinäkuun aikana. Palaamme rekrytointiprosessiin elokuun alussa, joten jätä hakemuksesi jo nyt, jotta ehdit mukaan hakuun!

Teemme turvallisuusselvityksen kaikille rekrytointiprosessin loppuvaiheeseen eteneville hakijoille.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.description:
About Twoday

Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 technologists, we collaborate with some of the most recognised private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our deep industry expertise spans Data & AI, software development, digital experiences and business applications.

Our team operates across the Nordics and Lithuania, supporting more than 8,000 customers on their digital transformation journeys.

NET Developers with Experience in Health Data, Clinical Systems or Public Healthcare Platforms

Twoday is looking for both a Senior .NET Developer and a Junior .NET Developer (two to three years of relevant experience after your education) for a long-term public-sector healthcare project in Copenhagen.

You will join Twoday as a permanent employee and work closely with one of Denmark's most important public healthcare organisations on solutions that support healthcare professionals, health data and critical public services.

The role

You will contribute to the development, maintenance and modernisation of complex .NET solutions in a highly regulated environment.

Depending on your experience level, your responsibilities may include:

Developing and maintaining .NET-based applications and services
Designing and implementing integrations and APIs
Working with health data and business-critical workflows
Collaborating with architects, developers, product owners and stakeholders
Participating in code reviews, testing and quality assurance
Contributing to secure, maintainable and scalable solutions

Senior candidates are expected to take a larger role in technical decision-making, solution design and mentoring.

Required Experience

We are specifically looking for candidates with experience from one or more of the following areas:

Electronic Patient Record (EPR/EPJ) systems
Health data platforms
Clinical systems
Patient-related workflows
Healthcare authorities
Public healthcare platforms
Solutions used directly by healthcare professionals
Healthcare integrations and healthcare-related data flows

Experience from administrative solutions alone (e.g. workforce planning, payroll or HR systems for healthcare organisations) is not considered sufficient for this role.

Senior profile

You typically have:

Several years of experience with C# and .NET
Experience working with complex integrations and APIs
Experience from health data, clinical systems or public healthcare platforms
Strong understanding of software quality, maintainability and security
Experience working with stakeholders in larger organisations

Junior profile

You typically have:

Two to three years of professional software development experience after having completed your education
Experience with C# and .NET
Experience from health data, clinical systems or public healthcare platforms
Understanding of APIs, databases and modern development practices
Desire to develop further in a strong professional environment

Technical environment

Experience with some of the following is expected:

C# / .NET
REST APIs
SQL Server
Entity Framework
Azure DevOps
CI/CD
Integration development
Automated testing

Language Requirements

Fluent Danish, both written and spoken, is required.

Location

The role is primarily onsite in the Copenhagen area.

Why Twoday

At Twoday, you will join one of the leading digital transformation partners in the Nordics and become part of a strong professional community where knowledge sharing, collaboration and continuous development are central.

What We Offer

Permanent employment with Twoday
Opportunity to work on meaningful, high-impact public sector solutions
Professional development in a strong technical environment
A collaborative and supportive team culture

If you are interested in contributing to impactful healthcare solutions and working closely with a key public sector client, we would love to hear from you.

The process

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect
to shape and own end-to-end technical solutions for large, complex Application Development & Maintenance (ADM) and Application Managed Services (AMS) engagements within our Public Sector business. You will translate government agency requirements and business objectives into robust, scalable, and secure architecture — spanning applications, integration, data, and cloud — and guide that architecture through design, build, and delivery.

This role sits at the intersection of client engagement and technical delivery: you'll work directly with government stakeholders during solutioning and bid activities, and partner closely with Business Analysts, Project/Delivery Managers, and engineering teams to ensure what's designed is what gets delivered — on time, within budget, and aligned to Singapore's public sector technology standards.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Architecture

Own end-to-end architecture design for large-scale ADM/AMS programs, covering application, integration, data, and infrastructure/cloud considerations as needed.
Translate client requirements, existing IT landscape, and business objectives into clear, well-structured solution architectures and design artefacts (high-level and low-level design).
Apply relevant architecture frameworks, standards, and methodologies (e.g., TOGAF or equivalent) to ensure solutions are consistent, scalable, and maintainable.
Define architecture components, reusable patterns, and technology choices appropriate to public sector constraints (security, data residency, compliance).
Design for cloud-native and microservices-based architectures where applicable, considering major cloud platforms and, where relevant, Singapore Government cloud environments.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders, including government agency representatives, articulating complex technical concepts clearly during workshops, whiteboarding sessions, and presentations.
Support pre-sales and bid activities: contribute to proposals, RFI/RFP responses, solution estimation, and technical win themes for Public Sector pursuits.
Engage with senior client and internal stakeholders to align architecture decisions with enterprise-wide strategy and delivery constraints.
Build strong working relationships with Business Analysts, Project/Delivery Managers, and cross-functional service line leads (Infrastructure, Security, Data & AI).

Delivery Collaboration & Governance

Partner with delivery teams throughout build, test, and deployment to ensure implementation stays true to the intended architecture.
Provide technical guidance and design assurance across the engagement lifecycle, resolving architecture-level risks and issues as they arise.
Support solution governance activities, including design reviews, architecture review boards, and quality assurance of technical deliverables.
Contribute to continuous improvement of solutioning practices, reusable frameworks, and architecture playbooks for the Public Sector portfolio.

What You Bring

Significant experience (typically 10–15+ years) in IT solutioning and architecture, including substantial time in Solution Architect or equivalent technical leadership roles.
Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale ADM/AMS solutions, ideally for, or in service of, Public Sector / government agency clients.
Strong understanding of the Singapore Public Sector technology landscape, or demonstrated ability to quickly build that understanding (e.g., relevant government cloud/technology frameworks).
Familiarity with microservices architecture, common application stacks (e.g., Java, .NET), data platforms, ERP, and major cloud platforms.
Working knowledge of architecture frameworks and open standards (e.g., TOGAF) and industry-standard delivery methodologies (Agile and traditional).
Experience contributing to pre-sales, proposals, or bid responses is an advantage.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with technical and CXO-level audiences alike.
Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and driving clarity through structured technical thinking.
Relevant tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience. Relevant certifications (e.g., TOGAF, cloud architecture certifications) are an advantage.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Emerging Systems)
jobs.description:
Job Description

DSO National Laboratories (DSO) is Singapore’s largest defence research and development (R&D) organisation, with the critical mission to develop technological solutions to sharpen the cutting edge of Singapore's national security. At DSO, you will develop more than just a career. This is where you will make a real impact and shape the future of defence across the spectrum of air, land, sea, space and cyberspace.

The Emerging Systems Division focuses research and development on a broad spectrum of capabilities that are critical to the Singapore Armed Forces (SAF) defence systems. These include antenna design and electromagnetics, as well as next-wave technologies in the areas of lasers and advanced materials.

People are DSO’s greatest asset. You will get to realise your career aspirations and develop your own niche either as a deep technical expert or a leader in the team. With frequent career dialogues and a robust training and development framework, we will provide you with the necessary development tools for you to reach your potential. You will also be recognised and rewarded through competitive remuneration packages and scholarship opportunities.

Software Engineer (Emerging Systems)

In This Role, You Will

Elicit software requirements based on users' needs and design a safe and secure software architecture
Write code which implements the software requirements and design test cases to verify the code
Work closely with the hardware team to carry out integration tests, both in the lab and field

If you are passionate about software development and enjoy working in cutting edge technological fields, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and help shape the future of SAF technology today!

Job Requirements

Degree/ Masters in Computer Science/ Computing/ Computer Engineering/ Electrical Engineering
Experience with C/ C++/ C#/ Python programming languages
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
Open-minded and comfortable interacting with engineers from other disciplines
Interesting in exploring and developing a variety of software, from embedded software to GUI development

ent

Position
Senior Software Engineer

Location
Bucharest, Romania

Senior Software Engineer

What this role is about?

You will design, build and operate modern cloud-based systems on the Microsoft stack, with a focus on .NET, Azure and GitHub.

This role requires strong ownership across the full lifecycle problem framing, system design, implementation, deployment and production operations. You’ll work on scalable, secure and maintainable systems, applying solid engineering fundamentals and using tools like GitHub Copilot pragmatically to accelerate delivery without compromising quality.

What will you do?

Build and evolve backend services and APIs using .NET, C#, and ASP.NET Core
Build and contribute to frontend experiences using React and TypeScrip
Design systems for scalability, resilience, security and maintainability
Make and drive technical decisions, balancing trade-offs and constraints
Own services in production, including deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting and continuous improvement
Apply clean architecture, design patterns, automated testing and code quality practices
Work with Azure services across compute, storage, messaging, identity, and monitoring to build cloud-based solutions
Collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product owners, and other stakeholders to deliver working software
Review code, challenge assumptions and help raise the engineering bar
Use AI-assisted tools, such as GitHub Copilot, effectively for coding, testing, analysis, and documentation

What are we looking for?

Strong experience building and operating software systems in production
Deep hands-on expertise with .NET, C#, and ASP.NET Core
Solid understanding of APIs, distributed systems and integration patterns
Proven experience with Azure and cloud-based application architecture
Strong grasp of system design, design patterns, performance, reliability, and security
Experience with automated testing, including unit and integration testing

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

UiPath’s Platform Engineering team builds the internal infrastructure and tooling that keeps engineering across UiPath fast, reliable, and consistent. That includes a hybrid cloud compute fleet - powering pipeline runs and other internal workloads on our own datacenter using virtualization technologies - alongside centralized initiatives like Automated product Sign-Off, performance testing, and the standardization of software development practices through tooling the team builds in-house.

You’ll help build the software and tooling that make these systems self-managing and easy to consume, so engineering teams across UiPath can ship faster and with more confidence.

What You'll Do At UiPath

Develop tooling that empowers engineering teams to consume datacenter compute as easily as a managed cloud service.
Build services that provision, configure, and lifecycle-manage virtual machines on bare metal using virtualization technologies.
Provide the compute backbone for pipeline runs, end-to-end and automated testing at scale.
Expose our datacenter capacity as a single elastic fabric that internal workloads can schedule against on demand.
Automate the full host lifecycle as code; bring-up, hypervisor configuration, networking, storage, and decommissioning.
Improve the reliability, observability, and performance of the virtualization layer, and harden it for security and scale.
Contribute to centralized initiatives such as Automated Sign-Off and performance testing, helping teams validate and ship releases with confidence.
Build and maintain tooling that standardizes software development practices across engineering teams.

What You'll Bring To The Team

5+ years in a software engineering role using one or more mainstream languages (.NET / C# preferred; Java, Go, C, C++, Python, or Rust).
Linux experience - comfortable operating and scripting on Linux.
Strong grasp of OOP, design patterns, concurrency, and data structures and algorithms.
Hands-on experience with cloud technologies (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP).
Experience with virtualization — QEMU/KVM, libvirt, VMware, Hyper-V, or Xen equivalents.
Well-versed with the full SDLC and able to produce well-tested, high-quality code.

Nice to have

Experience running bare-metal fleets or datacenter infrastructure at scale.
CI/CD and test infrastructure (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and how large test suites run at scale.
Familiarity with libvirt, cloud-init, PXE / network booting, and VM image pipelines; networking (VLANs, overlays, SDN).
Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible), Kubernetes, and distributed storage (Ceph, ZFS).

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is negotiable, the range being $6,000-$11,000 per month (Gross in USD), based on location and experience level.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation
:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is $6000 - $11000
per month, negotiable based on the skills and experience being brought to the table. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level.

This is a fully remote role
. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. You get principal-level scope and ownership at a growing fintech, competitive compensation, and no relocation or commute attached to it. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated best-in-class Principal Software Engineer to own and lead the evolution of authentication and authorization at Sezzle. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is investing in the next generation of its authentication and authorization platform, centered on a purpose-built API auth gateway and a clean set of identity and access management services. As the Principal Software Engineer leading this effort, you will own the technical vision, architecture, and migration strategy for this transformation.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Security, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with engineering teams across the organization to deliver auth capabilities that are safe, incremental to adopt, and invisible to customers. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering gateway and identity services, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates. Your work will generally focus on foundational platform capabilities, security-critical paths, and performance at the edge.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted development is a standard part of how we build, paired with the rigorous review and security discipline the auth-critical path demands. As a principal engineer, you will help set the pattern for how AI tooling is used well on security-sensitive systems.

Key Responsibilities

Own the technical vision and roadmap for Sezzle’s authentication and authorization platform, including a dedicated API auth gateway and supporting identity services.
Architect, design, and build scalable, highly-available auth services and gateway components primarily in Golang, leveraging AWS, RDS (MySQL/Postgres), and modern distributed patterns.
Design and lead phased, zero-downtime migrations of auth traffic and functionality, with clear rollback and safety mechanisms at every step.
Establish and evolve authentication and authorization standards across the platform: OAuth2/OIDC flows, token strategy (JWT, opaque, refresh), service-to-service auth (mTLS, workload identity), and fine-grained authorization models (RBAC/ABAC/policy engines).
Drive consistency and scalability across a distributed microservices architecture while maintaining the performance, reliability, and latency budgets expected of an edge gateway.
Partner with Security and Compliance to ensure the new platform meets fintech-grade security and regulatory requirements, and champion secure-by-default patterns across engineering.
Establish and evolve engineering best practices for observability, security, and CI/CD across teams, with particular rigor on the auth-critical path.
Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own, and help lead incident response and postmortems on the auth-critical path.
Mentor engineers and champion a culture of learning, innovation, and operational excellence.
Collaborate cross-functionally to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and deliver results that matter.

Minimum Requirements:

12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
Deep, hands-on expertise in authentication and authorization systems: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT and session-based auth, token lifecycle management, and modern authorization patterns (RBAC, ABAC, policy-as-code).
Experience designing, building, or operating an API gateway or auth proxy at scale: whether a commercial/open-source gateway (e.g., Kong, Envoy, AWS API Gateway, Traefik) or an in-house edge service.
Proven track record leading a large-scale service extraction or migration: decomposing a monolith or large legacy service into well-bounded services with zero or minimal customer impact.
Strong proficiency in Golang, with experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs.
Expertise with SQL-based RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and experience optimizing schema and queries for performance at scale.
Solid understanding of distributed systems design patterns (e.g., transactional outbox, event-driven architecture, queues) and the specific challenges of high-throughput, low-latency edge services.
Demonstrated ability to bring new ideas forward, influence decisions, and lead complex technical initiatives across many teams.
Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and help teammates adopt AI-assisted workflows.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required).

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

Experience with identity platforms and standards implementations (e.g., Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, Ory, or in-house IdPs), and familiarity with fine-grained authorization approaches (policy-as-code, relationship-based access control) as we centralize authorization over time.
Experience with service mesh and edge technologies (Envoy, Istio, mTLS, rate limiting, WAF integration).
Familiarity with threat modeling, secure design review, and common auth attack vectors (token theft, replay, CSRF, session fixation, privilege escalation).
Proficiency in observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic), especially for latency-sensitive edge services.
Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, mainly AWS Aurora RDS, both MySQL and Postgres.
Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending - familiarity with financial compliance (PCI-DSS, SOC 2), credit decisioning, or transaction processing systems.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized microservices (Docker, Kubernetes).
Track record of shipping commercial APIs and platform infrastructure in high-growth environments.
Proven leadership in guiding technical direction, improving system reliability, and scaling engineering organizations.

About You:

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
Backend: Golang
Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
Version Control: Git
CI/CD: Gitlab
Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation
:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is $12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level
per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Infrastructure Engineer
to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.

You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Our stack runs on AWS
, with workloads orchestrated on Kubernetes
and data anchored in Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres)
. You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.

Operational ownership is part of the job. You will participate in the on-call rotation
and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.

You will also build and apply AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling
for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.

This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.

What you’ll do:

Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.
Connect business understanding to improvements across the system: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.
Engineer for scale and performance: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.
Design and build AWS infrastructure: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.
Build and operate the Kubernetes platform: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.
Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.
Improve reliability through engineering: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.
Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.
Implement and test disaster recovery: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.
Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.
Build observability that makes production diagnosable: improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.
Deliver safe infrastructure migrations: design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.
Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes: right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.
Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling: apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.
Make technical decisions clear and executable: write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.

What We look for:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)
12+ years of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.
Deep expertise with AWS: production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.
Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production: cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.
Deep expertise with relational databases at scale, specifically RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres): query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.
A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements: identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.
Strong coding and automation skills, using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.
Strong systems fundamentals: Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.
Experience operating a 24/7, high-availability platform where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.
Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.
Experience implementing and testing disaster recovery against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.
Practical experience with observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices for shared production infrastructure.
Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations, with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.

samenwerken met andere teams
oplossingen voorzien die aan de hoge standaarden van Sopra Steria voldoen

Functie-eisen

We zijn op zoek naar gepassioneerde collega’s die graag de grenzen willen verleggen op het gebied van digitale transformatie en technologie consulting. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om te werken aan impactvolle projecten en je vaardigheden te ontwikkelen in een constructieve team omgeving.

Jij wilt tot de besten behoren. Dat is waarom jij altijd naar manieren zoekt om jouw kennis uit te breiden en op de hoogte te blijven van de laatste trends en ontwikkelingen. Angular

Entity Framework

API-ontwerp

OO-principes

Aanvullende informatie

Klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière? Dan wijzen we je graag in de juiste richting. Met kantoren in bijna 30 landen die je leiden naar plaatsen waar je nog nooit bent geweest. Wil je liever intern groeien? Ook dat is mogelijk. We dagen je uit om jezelf te blijven uitdagen en zo telkens de beste versie van jezelf te zijn.

Je krijgt een uitgebreid pakket voordelen, waaronder:

De mogelijkheid om in contact te komen met collega's van Sopra Steria tijdens verschillende teamevenementen.

Ons doel is om goed functionerende teams en gezonde werkomgevingen op te bouwen die elkaar inspireren en ondersteunen om uitmuntendheid te leveren aan al onze klanten. Enthousiast over deze jobopportuniteit? Klaar om samen met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Geweldig! We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

with 8+ years of hands-on expertise in Manufacturing Execution Systems to join our team. Strong knowledge of leading MES platforms, ISA-95, and Industry 4.0 reference architectures is essential.

Lead the design of end-to-end MES and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) solution architectures, including integration with ERP, PLC/SCADA, historians, LIMS, and emerging Unified Namespace / IIoT platforms.

Present solution architectures and value propositions to senior client stakeholders, both technical and executive.
Provide architectural governance during project delivery, ensuring that solutions are implemented in line with the design and adapt cleanly to evolving requirements.

Maintain deep expertise in leading MES platforms (e.g., Siemens Opcenter, TrakSYS, Rockwell FactoryTalk PharmaSuite/ProductionCentre, AVEVA MES, Werum PAS-X, Apriso, Critical Manufacturing, Tulip) and partner ecosystems.
Mentor junior MES engineers and consultants, sharing knowledge through coaching, internal training, and design reviews.

A background in Industrial / Automation / Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

Deep architectural thinking with the ability to balance technical excellence, business value, and delivery feasibility.
Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills, with the gravitas to engage at executive level.
Excellent commercial acumen and the ability to translate technical decisions into business outcomes.
Skilled at facilitating workshops and synthesizing complex client requirements into a clear solution narrative.

Ability to operate independently across multiple parallel opportunities while maintaining quality and pace.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to ambiguity.
Excellent written communication for proposals, statements of work, and architecture documentation.

Additional Considerations

Experience working in a consultancy, systems integrator, or vendor pre-sales environment is highly valued.
Familiarity with Industry 4.0, IIoT, AI/ML in manufacturing, and emerging UNS-based architectures will set strong candidates apart.
Willingness to travel periodically to client sites across the region.
Dutch written and spoken is required.

Cloud & platform operations (Azure)

Beheren en governen van onze Azure-subscripties voor R&D, go-to-market en interne systemen, inclusief kostenbeheer, capaciteit en toegangsbeheer.

Actief bijdragen aan onze internationale technische Centers of Excellence.

Microsoft Azure: subscription governance, cost management en monitoring.
CI/CD: Azure DevOps Pipelines en GitHub Actions. Ervaring met PowerShell- en YAML-scripting. Kennis van Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep/ARM).
Microsoft 365 en Entra ID: identity-, access- en tenantmanagement.
Affiniteit met AI-tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) en de onderliggende technologieën (zoals MCP en vergelijkbare concepten), aangevuld met inzicht in AI-gebruik en kostenbeheer.

Kennis van Dynamics 365 (F&SCM en/of CE) op platformniveau.

Ervaring binnen een Microsoft-partner- of consultancyomgeving.

jobs.title: (Senior) Cloud Solution Architect – Microsoft Azure (all genders)
jobs.description:
Bei uns kommen AI-Kompetenz, Engineering-Exzellenz und fundiertes Branchenverständnis zusammen – getragen von Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen wollen. So entstehen zukunftsfähige Lösungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Das gelingt durch Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Chancen erkennen und technologische Möglichkeiten in greifbare Ergebnisse verwandeln. Dafür schaffen wir ein Umfeld, das von gegenseitiger Unterstützung geprägt ist: Raum für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, offene Communities, in denen Wissen gerne geteilt wird, Peer Groups und Trainingsangebote, die sich an dir orientieren. Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und gemeinsam gefeierte Erfolge prägen dabei unser Miteinander und machen Entwicklung zu etwas, das bei uns einfach dazugehört.

DAS KANNST DU BEWEGEN

Azure Architektur: Du entwickelst moderne, sichere und skalierbare Azure-Architekturen und erstellst die Architekturplanung für die zu implementierende Lösung.
Cloud Foundation & Landing Zones: Du konzipierst Azure Landing Zones und gestaltest die technische Basis für Cloud-Transformationen – inklusive Management Groups, Subscriptions, Networking, Identity, Governance und Security.
Azure Migration & Modernisierung: Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Analyse, Planung und Umsetzung von Migrationen nach Azure und entwickelst bestehende IT-Landschaften gezielt weiter.
Hybrid Cloud & Networking: Du konzipierst hybride Architekturen und verbindest bestehende On-Premises-Umgebungen sicher mit Azure – beispielsweise mit Azure Virtual Network, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Private Endpoints und Azure DNS.
Security & Identity: Du integrierst Security von Beginn an in deine Architektur und arbeitest unter anderem mit Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy und Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Du automatisierst den Aufbau von Cloud-Infrastrukturen mit Technologien wie Terraform oder Bicep und integrierst diese in moderne CI/CD-Prozesse mit GitHub oder Azure DevOps.
Cloud-native Lösungen: Du berätst unsere Kunden auch beim Einsatz moderner Azure Services wie Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps oder Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Integration & APIs: Du kennst die Möglichkeiten von Azure API Management, Service Bus und Event Grid und kannst diese sinnvoll in moderne Lösungsarchitekturen integrieren.
Betrieb & Resilienz: Du berücksichtigst Monitoring, Verfügbarkeit, Backup und Disaster Recovery bereits im Lösungsdesign und nutzt dafür beispielsweise Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Backup und Azure Site Recovery.
Governance & Kosten: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, ihre Azure-Umgebung kontrollierbar und wirtschaftlich zu betreiben und berücksichtigst dabei Governance- und FinOps-Prinzipien.
Kundenberatung & Workshops: Du diskutierst Anforderungen auf Augenhöhe mit IT-Verantwortlichen und Architekten, moderierst Architektur- und Cloud-Workshops und übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete technische Lösungen.
PreSales & Angebote: Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales- und Microsoft-Team entwickelst du Lösungsansätze für neue Kundenprojekte und unterstützt bei Architekturkonzepten, Aufwandsschätzungen, Angeboten sowie Präsentationen.
Microsoft Ecosystem: Du arbeitest eng mit Microsoft und unseren internen Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten zusammen und bringst neue Azure-Technologien und Best Practices aktiv in unsere Kundenprojekte ein.
Teamarbeit: Du gibst dein Wissen weiter, unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns unser Microsoft Azure Portfolio weiter.

WIE DIR DAS GELINGT

Azure-Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure und der Konzeption sowie Umsetzung von Azure-basierten Kundenlösungen mit.
Infrastructure Know-how: Du verstehst klassische und moderne IT-Infrastrukturen und kennst dich insbesondere mit Cloud Networking, Compute, Storage, Identity, Security und hybriden Architekturen aus.
Architekturkompetenz: Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen analysieren, technische Optionen bewerten und daraus verständliche, sichere und skalierbare Lösungsarchitekturen entwickeln.
Azure Best Practices: Konzepte wie Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Landing Zones und Azure Well-Architected Framework sind dir vertraut.
Infrastructure as Code: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Terraform und/oder Bicep sowie mit Automatisierungs- und Deployment-Prozessen.
Security: Zero Trust, Identity & Access Management, Network Security, Governance und Cloud Security sind für dich integraler Bestandteil einer Architektur und keine nachgelagerten Themen.
Modernisierung: Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit Azure Migrate sowie mit PaaS-, Container- oder Kubernetes-basierten Architekturen gesammelt.
DevOps: GitHub, GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps sowie CI/CD-Konzepte sind dir vertraut.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich erklären, trittst beim Kunden sicher auf und entwickelst Lösungen gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst gerne technische Verantwortung und möchtest Lösungen nicht nur konzipieren, sondern deren Umsetzung aktiv begleiten.
Zertifizierungen: Microsoft Azure Zertifizierungen wie Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) sind ein Plus – oder du bist bereit, entsprechende Zertifizierungen bei uns zu erlangen.
KI-Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
Reisebereitschaft & Flexibilität: Du bist bereit, projektbezogen zu reisen, und arbeitest gern in agilen Teams.

CHANCENGEBER - WAS ADESSO AUSMACHT

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, gemeinschaftlich und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Lerne und wachse mit uns: Mit über 400 Trainingsangeboten und unserer digitalen Lernplattform unterstützen wir deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung.
Erlebe echten Teamgeist: Gemeinsame Events (z.B. Sport-Weekend und die jährliche Fortbildungsreise eduCamp), Welcome Days, Firmenläufe stärken unseren Zusammenhalt und lassen dich von Anfang an Teil des Teams sein.
Engagement, das belohnt wird: Dein Einsatz zahlt sich aus – mit Prämien für Empfehlungen, Vorträge, die Betreuung von Abschlussarbeiten sowie attraktiven Vergünstigungen über unser Corporate-Benefits-Portal.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns – auch im Home-Office. Arbeiten in Teilzeit ist nach Absprache möglich (80-100%). Zum wiederholten Mal wurden wir zu einem der besten Arbeitgeber der Schweiz gekürt! Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with a strong backend lean
to join the team that builds and evolves the platform powering this experience. You will work on the Research Topic Management (RTM)
application — a distributed .NET system with Vue/Nuxt frontends, SQL Server-heavy data operations, Github/Azure DevOps-driven deployments, and async integration workflows connecting multiple internal services.

This is a senior role where autonomy, ownership, and technical leadership
are central. You will own complex backend systems and full-stack features end-to-end — from specification refinement and architectural decisions, through implementation, to production monitoring and incident resolution. You will work on real production systems where SQL performance, distributed reliability, and integration correctness matter daily.

We have fully embraced AI-based spec-driven design
, integrating AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle — using skills, rules, multi-agent workflows, and automation for code review, testing, and code analysis. From specification to implementation, AI tooling shapes how we architect, build, and iterate, making us faster, more deliberate, and focused on what matters most. This isn't an experiment. It's how we work.

Your work directly enables researchers worldwide to collaborate, publish openly, and push science forward.

Science advances fastest when researchers can collaborate across boundaries — institutional, geographic, and disciplinary. Research Topics
are how Frontiers makes that happen.

Each Research Topic is a themed collection of peer-reviewed articles built around an emerging or critical area of science. Leading researchers from around the world propose a theme, invite contributors, and curate the resulting work — transforming scattered individual efforts into a coherent, openly accessible body of knowledge. When complete, every collection is published as a free ebook, available to anyone, anywhere.

These are not just publications. They are communities of researchers working together toward answers that matter: healthier lives, a more sustainable planet, a deeper understanding of the world we share.

The Research Topic Management (RTM)
application is the platform that makes this possible at scale. It supports the full lifecycle — from the moment a researcher proposes a topic, through editorial coordination, contributor recruitment, and submission tracking, all the way to publication and closure. RTM gives the teams behind Frontiers the tools they need to turn a scientific idea into open, lasting knowledge — one collection at a time.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities
:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications using .NET, Vue.js, and Nuxt
Modernise and replace legacy systems — including migrating older Angular applications to our current Vue and Nuxt stack
Own full-stack projects end-to-end, from specification refinement through delivery to production monitoring
Collaborate with product managers, architects, and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and determine the best implementation strategy
Work effectively within a multinational, cross-functional team to deliver software aligned with business needs
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, and uphold engineering best practices across the team
Ensure the quality of delivered solutions through robust testing and review
Optimise applications for performance, scalability, and responsiveness
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges across distributed systems
Leverage AI tooling to raise the quality, speed, and consistency of engineering work
Stay current with emerging technologies and bring fresh thinking to keep our stack modern
Maintain a business-oriented mindset, focused on delivering measurable outcomes for end-users

Required Skills and Experience
:

5+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in .NET Core / .NET Framework
3+ years of hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks (Vue 3 a plus) — and a solid command of the fundamentals: JavaScript, CSS, and HTML are a must
Strong expertise in Vue.js (Vue 2 and Vue 3), with a solid grasp of state management, component-based architecture, and best practices for building scalable front-end applications
Strong expertise in SQL Server: performance tuning, indexing strategies, query optimisation, and troubleshooting production issues
Extensive experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Experience or strong interest in applying AI to product features and engineering workflows
Experience owning complex, distributed system architectures
Solid understanding of microservices and micro-frontend concepts
Comfortable working in Kanban
Collaborative, with proven autonomy and ownership, and able to thrive in a hybrid environment

Experience with Nuxt
Experience with GraphQL (strong SQL knowledge transfers well here)
Experience with NoSQL databases

Experience with containerization platforms (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps)

jobs.title: Platform Engineering Manager - Platform Shared Services
jobs.description:
About Frontiers

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

The Mission

At Frontiers, we are rewriting the rules of scientific publishing. Behind every product team sit the shared technical services the whole publishing platform depends on. Today these are Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Messaging (transactional email and GDPR-compliant consent) — examples of this kind of shared service, with more likely over time — owned by our Platform Shared Services team. We are looking for a Platform Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs them.

You will own team delivery, technical direction (in partnership with your Senior Engineers), and the people development of a team of [5-8] engineers. These are high-blast-radius services consumed org-wide, so you'll balance shipping new capability with reliability, security and backward compatibility — treating the services as products for internal engineering customers. You'll form a delivery triad with the team's Platform Product Manager (who owns the What/Why) and your Senior Engineers (who drive the How).

The Technical Context

You will lead delivery across the team's shared-service lines — today IAM and Messaging.

IAM: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC (Ory Hydra), JWT authorization, fine-grained authz via a Permission API (Ory Keto), Azure APIM, OAuth client tooling, shared .NET libraries
Messaging: transactional/outreach email at scale (SendGrid, Mailgun), templating and A/B testing, deliverability tooling, and a central GDPR consent authority (Subscription Management)
Core stack: C#/.NET services on Microsoft Azure + Kubernetes (AKS); event-driven with RabbitMQ and Kafka; SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch
Delivery & reliability: CI/CD, observability (New Relic, Grafana), SLAs/SLOs and incident management
Ways of working: Spec-Driven / AI-First Delivery (PRDs/SDDs in git, the Technology Framework as executable context, Cursor, MCP) — available to help the team deliver faster and more safely

What You'll Do

Lead the team day to day — oversee operations, resource allocation and task assignment across the IAM and Messaging portfolio
Turn roadmap into execution — translate the shared-services roadmap and portfolio objectives (owned with the Platform PM) into actionable engineering plans; ensure delivery aligns with department and wider engineering goals
Own team delivery — for authentication, messaging and related infrastructure: coordinate resources, manage risk, and deliver outcomes for the many teams that depend on these services
Partner with the Platform Product Manager — align roadmap priorities with technical feasibility, reliability and platform health; push back with technical reality where needed
Guide technical direction with your Senior Engineers — you don't need to be hands-on daily, but you provide enough depth to steer decisions on authentication and messaging infrastructure and to review architecture and design proposals
Develop people — set clear expectations, give regular feedback, support career growth, and run performance management for the team
Own reliability & operational excellence at the team level — SLAs/SLOs, incident management, and blameless post-incident follow-through; protect the team from unbounded toil
Improve process — identify and implement improvements that increase delivery efficiency and reliability across the team and portfolio
Represent the team cross-functionally — drive alignment with the engineering teams that consume shared services; escalate and manage significant technical/delivery risks to senior leadership

Requirements

Management experience: minimum 4 + years directly managing engineering teams, in addition to prior hands-on software engineering experience
Delivery track record: proven delivery of backend, platform, or infrastructure services; experience managing teams responsible for shared/platform services (authentication, messaging, APIs) strongly preferred
Technical depth (to steer, not to code daily): solid background in backend engineering and distributed systems — enough to guide decisions on authentication and messaging infrastructure and review design proposals with senior engineers
Reliability & delivery practices: working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and service reliability (SLAs/SLOs, incident management)
Platform / shared-services understanding: how internal engineering teams operate as service providers to the rest of the org
People & delivery balance: organised and outcome-driven, comfortable balancing people management (:60%) with technical/business activities (:40%)
Planning: budget/resource planning experience for a team
Communication & judgement: clear communicator across technical and non-technical stakeholders; sound decision-making and comfort resolving ambiguity
Language: Professional-level English (spoken and written)

Nice to Have

Hands-on background with authentication/identity (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT) and/or messaging/event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes (AKS), and .NET/C# environments
Familiarity with GDPR / consent and security/compliance as part of the delivery bar
Experience leading a team through a CI/CD or platform migration
Interest in Spec-Driven Development and enabling an AI-First delivery workflow for the team (Cursor, MCP, the Technology Framework)
Background in Scientific Publishing

How We Measure Success In This Role

Delivery: predictable, healthy throughput against the shared-services roadmap; risks surfaced and managed early
Reliability: SLAs/SLOs met for owned services; incident trend and quality of post-incident follow-through
People: team health, retention, growth and clear performance management
Consumer outcomes: satisfaction/adoption from the engineering teams that depend on IAM and Messaging
Security & compliance: the team's output meets the Technology Framework bar (OAuth/JWT, GDPR consent)

Why This Role Is Exciting

You'll lead the team behind two of Frontiers' highest-leverage capabilities: get identity and messaging right, and every product team ships faster and safer. It's a rare mix of real people leadership
, technical direction on interesting distributed systems
, and platform-as-a-product
thinking — all in service of a mission that matters: making science open for everyone.

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

Equal opportunity statement

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

, you’ll work with customers to modernise legacy applications and databases as they migrate to AWS. You will be a technical authority in designing and delivering cloud-native architectures, serverless solutions, application and database modernisation strategies. This role combines hands-on technical work, customer consulting, and practice development, helping us define and scale modernisation offerings.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Solution Design

Engage with customers to understand their legacy application and database environments.
Define modernisation strategies, focusing on database migration, re-platforming, and serverless adoption.
Design AWS architectures that are scalable, secure, and cost-optimised.
Act as a trusted advisor, providing technical leadership to both internal teams and customers.

Database Modernisation & Migration

Lead modernisation efforts for SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases.
Drive migrations using AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), Schema Conversion Tool (SCT), and Babelfish for Aurora.
Implement Amazon RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, and ElastiCache to replace legacy databases.
Optimise database performance through sharding, partitioning, and caching strategies.

Cloud-Native & Serverless Adoption

Architect solutions leveraging AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, and EventBridge.
Support customers in breaking down monolithic applications into microservices.
Define event-driven and asynchronous processing patterns to improve scalability.

Infrastructure as Code & DevOps

Automate database deployments using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and AWS CDK.
Integrate database changes into CI/CD pipelines using tools like Flyway or Liquibase.
Define observability and monitoring strategies using CloudWatch, X-Ray, and Prometheus.

Practice & Team Development

Contribute to the development of modernisation frameworks, methodologies, and best practices.
Help shape packaged offerings, including AWS MAP-funded modernisation engagements.
Mentor junior architects and engineers, fostering a high-performance technical culture.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Expertise

AWS Database Services – RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQL Server), Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache.
Database Migration – Experience with AWS DMS, SCT, and heterogeneous migrations.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK.
Cloud-Native & Serverless – AWS Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, ventBridge.
DevOps & CI/CD – GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, database schema versioning (Flyway/Liquibase).
AI-Powered development experience
Security & Compliance – IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, AWS Backup, GDPR considerations.
Performance Tuning & Optimisation – Query tuning, indexing, caching, connection pooling.

Consulting & Leadership Skills

Proven experience in customer-facing solution architecture or technical consulting.
Strong ability to communicate complex technical concepts to business and technical stakeholders.
Experience leading technical teams and mentoring engineers.
Ability to define modernisation roadmaps and business cases.

Desirable Skills (Nice-to-Have)

Experience with Redshift, Neptune, Timestream, or other AWS data services.
Knowledge of multi-cloud (GCP/Azure) and hybrid cloud environments.
Familiarity with machine learning & analytics pipelines on AWS.
Experience working on AWS MAP-funded modernisation projects.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission
and what we offer
.

Introduction

We're looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our team and take on a critical role in optimizing and extending our Microsoft Business Central (BC) environment. In this high-impact position, you will contribute to the configuration, customization, and integration of BC to support seamless business operations. You'll play a key role in building robust integrations with third-party applications, managing the underlying infrastructure, and leading our migration to the cloud-based version of BC. If you have hands-on experience with BC development, enjoy solving complex integration challenges, and are passionate about delivering scalable enterprise solutions, we want to hear from you.

This role is ideal for a strong full-stack engineer with expertise in ERP systems, particularly Microsoft Business Central, who thrives on tweaking configurations, deploying updates, and ensuring reliable data flows across our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Configure, customize, and extend Microsoft Business Central using AL (Application Language) or C/AL, including building and maintaining custom pages, reports, and extensions to meet business needs.
Design, develop, and deploy integrations between Business Central and third-party applications via APIs (e.g., OData web services, REST APIs), enabling data synchronization for workflows like inventory, finance, and CRM.
Manage and optimize the Microsoft SQL Server database that powers Business Central, ensuring data integrity, performance tuning, high availability, and compliance with best practices.
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for efficient deployment, testing, and versioning of BC customizations and extensions.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver solutions that enhance operational efficiency.
Lead the planning and execution of our migration from on-premises Business Central to the cloud (SaaS) version, including data migration, configuration transfer, and minimal downtime strategies.
Uphold security, reliability, and monitoring standards for BC environments, including role-based access, audit trails, and proactive issue resolution.
Participate in on-call rotations as needed to support production systems and contribute to process improvements for faster incident response.

Qualifications

Requirements

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Business Central development, including configuration, extension building, and customization using AL/C/AL.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server management, including querying, indexing, backup/recovery, and performance optimization.
Expertise in CI/CD practices and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, PowerShell scripting) for deploying and managing BC updates and extensions.
Proven track record in building API-based integrations (RESTful, SOAP, OData) with third-party systems, such as Salesforce, Shopify, or custom apps.
A strong product mindset with a focus on user experience, including designing intuitive extensions and workflows within BC.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to break down complex problems into actionable milestones that deliver quick value.
Curiosity and drive for continuous learning, especially around Microsoft ecosystem updates and cloud technologies.
Familiarity with ERP concepts and business processes (e.g., finance, supply chain) is essential.

Qualifications

We recognize that few candidates will have every skill listed, and we're committed to supporting your growth. If you meet most of these and are excited to dive deeper into Business Central, we'd love to talk!

Nice-to-Haves

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 integrations or other ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).
Knowledge of cloud migration strategies for Business Central, including Azure-based deployments and hybrid setups.
Proficiency in Power Platform tools (e.g., Power Automate, Power BI) for enhancing BC workflows.
Background in agile methodologies and version control with Git.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

new_jobs.description:
Software ontwikkelen waar de hele samenleving mee in aanraking komt. Samen met je DevOps-team. Software voor geboorteregistratie tot pensioenuitkering, van planningssystemen in het OV tot de software voor de robotisering van distributiecentra. Veilig, betrouwbaar, 100% vakmanschap. Met jouw drive om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen in jouw vakgebied wil je uitgroeien tot de top van de IT.

Om je goed voor te bereiden op het werk binnen onze projecten, start je met verschillende vakinhoudelijke trainingen. Daarna word je onderdeel van een van onze DevOps-teams en ga je aan de slag voor een klant. Samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en opleveren van een functionaliteit of voor de gehele applicatie. Je werkt vanuit verschillende disciplines nauw samen en zet het technisch ontwerp op. Daarvan bouw jij een deel, of het geheel van de programmatuur. Samen met de Requirements Engineer schrijf je de technische programmaspecificaties. Tijdens het project controleer, test en onderhoud je de software. Je vindt constant manieren om de applicatie te verbeteren.

Wat bied jij Info Support?

Je bent een ambitieuze developer die kwaliteit levert. Je leert snel vanwege je diepgaande interesse in IT, staat met beide benen op de grond en kunt goed samenwerken. Je bijt je graag vast in complexe vraagstukken, zodat jij de beste oplossing kan bieden aan de klant.

Verder heb jij:

Een afgeronde bachelor/master ICT of gelijkwaardig;
Een passie voor softwareontwikkeling;
Ambitie om je te ontwikkelen tot een ware vakprofessional;
Een brede interesse in het Java of .NET-platform;
Maximaal 3 jaar werkervaring als softwareontwikkelaar.

Wat biedt Info Support jou?

Uiteraard bieden we je een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden met verschillende keuzemogelijkheden. Denk hierbij aan:

Vakantiegeld, winstuitkering, onkostenvergoeding, bijdrage pensioen
Leasebudget met tankpas (ook voor het buitenland)
Laptop en smartphone (of BYOD), facilitering thuiswerkplek
Een startsalaris vanaf €3.400 bruto, op basis van 40 uur

Gedurende de eerste twee jaar van je dienstverband volg je onder werktijd naast vakinhoudelijke cursussen en opleidingen regelmatig sociale, bedrijfskundige en commerciële trainingen. Na die twee jaar kan je daardoor eventueel al doorgroeien naar andere rollen.

Ook na de eerste twee jaar krijgt je alle ruimte om je nog verder te ontwikkelen en je doelen en ambities waar te maken. Daar helpen we je bij door samen met jou een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan op te stellen waarin jij op inhoudelijk én persoonlijk vlak nog verder kunt groeien.

Daarnaast biedt Info Support jou:

Collegiale en gepassioneerde IT-collega’s die je continu uitdagen en verder brengen
Veel vrijheid in hoe je je werk indeelt en uitvoert
Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende bedrijven die ervoor kiezen hun complexe vraagstukken bij Info Support neer te leggen
Een gegarandeerde plek in een van onze communities waar je op de hoogte blijft van de allerlaatste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied
Veel ruimte voor vakinhoudelijke en persoonlijke ontwikkeling door opleiding, training, coaching en conferenties
Leuke team-, unit- en bedrijfsuitjes en de mogelijkheid om je aan te sluiten bij de kook-, boeken-, gaming-, cycle-, muziek- of (mud)runclub of een nieuwe club te starten
Werken bij een solide groeiende en financieel gezonde werkgever!

Over Info Support

Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Een betrouwbare cloudomgeving vraagt om slimme validatie en continu inzicht. In deze opdracht breid je ons deploymentproces uit met innovatieve controles die direct na uitrol de werking en stabiliteit van Azure-platformen bevestigen. Zo versterk je de monitoring op ‘drift’ en afwijkingen en bouw je mee aan een toekomstvast, foutbestendig platformlandschap.

Veel organisaties gebruiken geautomatiseerde deployment pipelines voor het uitrollen van platformen in de cloud, vaak met tools als Kubernetes, Helm, Bicep en ArgoCD. Hoewel deze processen technisch betrouwbaar zijn, ontbreekt vaak een automatische controle op de functionele werking van het platform na een deployment. Om de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van platformuitrol te verbeteren, is het waardevol om aanvullende validatie- en consistentiecontroles toe te voegen. Daarmee ontstaat beter inzicht in de impact van wijzigingen en updates. Ook maakt het detecteren van ‘drift’ het mogelijk om sneller bij te sturen en de stabiliteit te vergroten.

De opdracht

Ontwikkel een methode om Azure-platformen na deployment te valideren en te controleren op consistentie met de beoogde configuratie. Denk hierbij aan het testen van de werking van individuele resources, het detecteren van afwijkingen (‘drift’) en het veilig uitvoeren van deze controles zonder impact op klantomgevingen.Je onderzoekt:

Hoe je kunt bepalen of Azure-resources juist zijn aangemaakt op basis van Helm-configuratie en het resultaat van de deployments.
Hoe je kunt vaststellen of deze resources correct functioneren.
Hoe je afwijkingen detecteert, zoals resources die niet (meer) in de configuratie staan.
Hoe je teams automatisch kunt waarschuwen bij afwijkingen.
Welke tooling en technieken geschikt zijn.
